questions.q: Which spaces do interstitial animals in Dokdo's sandy sediments mainly occupy?
questions.fact: Interstitial animals occupy [[spaces between sediment grains]] within sandy sediments.
questions.explain: Sand is not a solid block without gaps. Tiny marine animals can live in the spaces between its grains.

wrong.1: The question concerns sediment spaces, not another animal's body.
wrong.2: This is not the space between grains of seabed sand.

questions.src: International Court of Justice · The Court · https://www.icj-cij.org/court
questions.q: How many judges make up the International Court of Justice (ICJ)?
questions.fact: The International Court of Justice has [[15 judges]] on its bench.
questions.explain: The ICJ has a bench of 15 independent judges. Its size does not equal the number of countries or UN members.

wrong.0: The question asks about the full complement, not possible vacancies.

questions.src: ITLOS · M/V Saiga, dissenting opinion reproducing UNCLOS Article 73 in paragraph 4 · https://itlos.org/fileadmin/itlos/documents/cases/1/C1-J-4_Dec_97-DO_PNCVN.pdf
questions.q: Under UNCLOS Article 73, what condition is linked to prompt release after an EEZ fisheries arrest?
choices: a change to the coastal state's nationality
donation of all catches to an international body
provision of a reasonable bond or other security
permanent immigration applications by the crew
questions.fact: Article 73 links prompt release of arrested vessels and crews to [[provision of a reasonable bond or other security]] under its fisheries rules.
questions.distractor: a change to the coastal state's nationality
questions.explain: Article 73(2) requires prompt release upon a reasonable bond or other security. Release does not itself erase the alleged violation.
blankDistractors: a change to the coastal state's nationality
donation of all catches to an international body
permanent immigration applications by the crew

wrong.0: The article does not make a change of nationality the release condition.
wrong.3: The rule concerns bond or other security, not immigration.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part XIII · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part13.htm
questions.q: Under UNCLOS Article 261, what must research equipment avoid causing on established international shipping routes?
questions.fact: Article 261 prohibits [[an obstruction to navigation]] arising from research equipment on established international shipping routes.
questions.explain: A scientific purpose does not authorize blocking shipping routes. Article 261 addresses navigation when research equipment is deployed or used.

wrong.0: The provision does not prohibit disclosing equipment locations.
wrong.1: The article targets obstruction of navigation, not temperature measurement itself.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 독도의 자연환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=67 | 한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · Marine Ecosystem Modelling · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/eng/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=219
questions.q: What is the approximate water depth at the observation buoy 3.2 km east of Dokdo?
questions.fact: The observation buoy 3.2 km east of Dokdo is deployed in approximately [[140 m]] of water.
questions.explain: This observing site measures water properties at different depths in roughly 140 m of water. That is not the average depth of all waters around Dokdo.

wrong.2: This is a different depth scale from that of the buoy site.

questions.src: NOAA · Are corals animals or plants? · https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/coral.html
questions.q: What kind of organism is the living polyp that forms a coral?
questions.fact: A living coral polyp is [[an animal]] in biological classification.
questions.explain: Corals may look like rocks or plants, but their polyps are animals. Photosynthetic algae living with some corals are not the coral animals themselves.

wrong.0: Distinguish symbiotic algae from the coral animal.
wrong.2: Coral polyps belong to animals, not fungi.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 독도의 자연환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=67
questions.q: Why do upper-layer temperatures near Dokdo become more uniform with depth in February and March?
choices: uniform warming solely from seabed heat
conversion of the entire water column to fresh water
complete removal of salt at high tide
questions.fact: Near Dokdo, [[active vertical mixing]] helps make upper-layer temperatures more uniform in late winter.
questions.distractor: uniform warming solely from seabed heat
questions.explain: The official account links uniform upper-layer temperatures in February and March to vertical mixing. This process mixes water from different depths.
blankDistractors: uniform warming solely from seabed heat
conversion of the entire water column to fresh water
complete removal of salt at high tide

wrong.0: The stated explanation is vertical mixing.
wrong.1: Similar temperatures do not mean that seawater has lost its salt.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전, 울릉도(유치환 시집) · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0040444
questions.q: Which poet published the poetry collection Ulleungdo in 1948?
questions.fact: [[Yu Chi-hwan]] published the poetry collection Ulleungdo in 1948.
questions.explain: Ulleungdo was Yu Chi-hwan's third poetry collection. The island's name appears in post-liberation literature as well as geographical records.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 중형저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=83
questions.q: What fine mesh retains meiofauna in the size definition used by Dokdo's interstitial-fauna guide?
questions.fact: The guide's meiofauna size definition uses a fine mesh of [[32 µm]] to retain animals passing through a 1 mm sieve.
questions.explain: This guide uses animals passing a 1 mm sieve but retained by a 32 µm sieve. Not every study uses the same mesh-size convention.

wrong.2: This is twice the fine-mesh size specified here.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 중형저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=83
questions.q: Which group dominated the 2006–2010 survey of interstitial fauna around Dokdo?
questions.fact: [[Nematodes]] were the most abundant group in the 2006–2010 survey of interstitial fauna around Dokdo.
questions.explain: Nematodes occurred at every station in that survey. A result from this survey should not be turned into a ranking for every seabed worldwide.

questions.src: NOAA · What is the difference between an AUV and a ROV? · https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/auv-rov.html
questions.q: Which connection usually distinguishes an ROV from an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV)?
choices: a direct link to an orbiting satellite
a tether to a support vessel
wings joining it to the sea surface
questions.fact: An ROV normally uses [[a tether to a support vessel]] for control and data transmission.
questions.distractor: a direct link to an orbiting satellite
questions.explain: An ROV is normally controlled through a tether from a vessel. An AUV performs its underwater mission without that physical tether.
blankDistractors: a direct link to an orbiting satellite
wings joining it to the sea surface

wrong.0: The usual ROV connection asked about is a cable to the vessel.
wrong.1: The vehicle is not permanently glued to the seabed.

questions.src: International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea · Statute, Articles 1, 2, 5 · https://itlos.org/fileadmin/itlos/documents/basic_texts/statute_en.pdf
questions.q: In which city is the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS) seated?
questions.fact: The seat of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea is in [[Hamburg]], as specified in its Statute.
questions.explain: The Tribunal's Statute places its seat in Hamburg, Germany. It is distinct from the International Court of Justice in The Hague.

wrong.0: This confuses ITLOS with the International Court of Justice.
wrong.2: This German city is not the seat specified in the Statute.

questions.src: International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea · Members · https://itlos.org/en/main/the-tribunal/members/
questions.q: What is the full number of members of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea?
questions.fact: The International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea consists of [[21 members]] elected by the States Parties.
questions.explain: ITLOS is composed of 21 independent members elected by the States Parties. Different international courts have different sizes.

wrong.1: This is one member short of the full complement.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part VI · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part6.htm
questions.q: Under UNCLOS Article 81, who has the exclusive right to authorize and regulate drilling on a continental shelf?
choices: the first state to send a drilling vessel
the company selling the drilling equipment
the first institution to map the seabed
questions.fact: Under Article 81, [[the coastal state]] has the exclusive right to authorize and regulate drilling on the continental shelf for all purposes.
questions.distractor: The first state to send a drilling vessel
questions.explain: Article 81 covers coastal-state authorization and regulation of drilling for all purposes. Arriving first with a vessel does not replace that right.
blankDistractors: the first state to send a drilling vessel
the company selling the drilling equipment
the first institution to map the seabed

wrong.0: The rule does not allocate drilling authority on a first-arrival basis.
wrong.2: Selling equipment does not confer the legal authority.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 독도의 자연환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=67
questions.q: In which year was an automatic weather station (AWS) installed near the summit of Dongdo (East Islet)?
questions.fact: An automatic weather station was installed near the summit of Dongdo (East Islet) in [[1996]], in March.
questions.explain: The March 1996 AWS installation introduced automatic observation. The start of manual measurements and the start of automation were different milestones.

questions.src: NOAA Ocean Exploration · What is vertical migration of zooplankton and why does it matter? · https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/ocean-fact/vertical-migration/
questions.q: What is the typical daily vertical-migration pattern of many zooplankton?
choices: down at night and up by day
fixed to the seabed both day and night
up at night and down by day
questions.fact: Many zooplankton migrate [[up at night and down by day]] in a typical daily cycle.
questions.distractor: down at night and up by day
questions.explain: Many feed nearer the surface at night and return deeper before sunrise. This is a common pattern, not a rule followed by every species.
blankDistractors: down at night and up by day
fixed to the seabed both day and night

wrong.0: This reverses the typical pattern asked about.
wrong.1: Vertical migration involves moving between depths.

questions.src: 국회도서관 독도 · 독도 연표 2001년 이후 · https://dokdo.nanet.go.kr/dokdo/front.dokdo?menu=chronology_9
questions.q: According to the National Assembly Library chronology, when was the first 1:5,000 Dokdo nautical chart published?
questions.fact: The chronology dates the first 1:5,000 Dokdo nautical chart to [[2001]], on July 26.
questions.explain: The chronology records publication on July 26, 2001. Distinguish this nautical chart from earlier land topographic maps.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전, 신증동국여지승람 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0033401
questions.q: Which pair is associated with compiling the expanded Sinjeung Dongguk Yeoji Seungnam?
questions.fact: [[Yi Haeng and Yun Eun-bo]] were among the officials responsible for compiling Sinjeung Dongguk Yeoji Seungnam.
questions.explain: Yi Haeng, Yun Eun-bo and others expanded the earlier work. Distinguish this team from those involved in the original work and earlier revisions.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 어류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=89
questions.q: Which fish does the Gajicho survey describe schooling around large black corals near Dokdo?
questions.fact: The Gajicho survey describes [[Dohwabolrak rockfish]] schooling around large black corals near Dokdo.
questions.explain: The survey account describes schools of Dohwabolrak around large black corals at Gajicho. This asks about a particular habitat observation.

wrong.3: The question asks which fish is described schooling at this site.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해저퇴적물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=96
questions.q: Why are X-ray images useful when examining sediment cores from the seabed around Dokdo?
choices: directly measuring wind above the sea
questions.fact: X-ray images of sediment cores are useful for [[examining internal sediment structures]] without relying only on the outer surface.
questions.explain: X-rays reveal layering and structures that may be missed from the outside. An image alone does not establish the absolute age of every layer.
blankDistractors: directly measuring wind above the sea

wrong.0: X-ray imaging is not a method of recording fish sounds.
wrong.1: The object being examined is a seabed sediment core.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part XII · https://static.un.org/Depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part12.htm
questions.q: Which introduction of alien or new species is addressed by UNCLOS Article 196?
choices: introductions risking significant and harmful marine changes
all movements with no environmental effects
translation of species names into another language
questions.fact: Article 196 addresses [[introductions risking significant and harmful marine changes]] under its marine-environment provisions.
questions.explain: The article covers intentional or accidental introduction of alien or new species to a marine environment. It is not a blanket ban on every movement of every species.
blankDistractors: all movements with no environmental effects
translation of species names into another language

wrong.2: This differs from the harmful introductions addressed by the article.
wrong.3: Introducing organisms is different from translating their names.

questions.src: NOAA · How does pressure change with ocean depth? · https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/pressure.html
questions.q: About how many metres of descent in seawater add roughly one atmosphere of pressure?
questions.fact: In seawater, roughly [[10 m]] of additional depth adds about one atmosphere of pressure.
questions.explain: About one atmosphere is added for each 10 m of descent. Total pressure also includes the atmospheric pressure already present at the surface.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part XIII · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part13.htm
questions.q: Under UNCLOS Article 241, what cannot be based on marine scientific research activities themselves?
choices: observations used to explain marine processes
information used to design further studies
a legal basis for claims to the marine environment or resources
questions.fact: Marine scientific research activities cannot themselves form [[a legal basis for claims to the marine environment or resources]] under Article 241.
questions.explain: Scientific research and acquisition of legal rights are different matters. A research vessel's first visit does not itself confer those rights.
blankDistractors: observations used to explain marine processes
information used to design further studies

wrong.0: Producing scientific observations is different from creating a legal basis for claims.
wrong.3: The article does not prohibit scientific use of temperature records.

questions.src: International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea · Members · https://itlos.org/en/main/the-tribunal/members/ | International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea · Statute, Articles 1, 2, 5 · https://itlos.org/fileadmin/itlos/documents/basic_texts/statute_en.pdf
questions.q: What is the normal term of office for a member of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea?
questions.fact: A normal term for an ITLOS member lasts [[9 years]] under the Tribunal's rules.
questions.explain: Members are elected for nine years and may be re-elected. The three-year election cycle for one third of the bench is not the length of an individual term.

questions.src: 국회도서관 독도 · 독도 연표 1966~2000 · https://dokdo.nanet.go.kr/dokdo/front.dokdo?menu=chronology_8
questions.q: In which year did Kim Seong-do and his wife move their resident registration to Seodo (West Islet)?
questions.fact: Kim Seong-do and his wife transferred their resident registration to Seodo (West Islet) in [[1991]], on November 17.
questions.explain: The chronology records this transfer on November 17, 1991. It is distinct from Choi Jong-deok's registration and Kim Seong-do's later national-tax payment.

questions.src: NOAA · What is the difference between a nautical mile and a knot? · https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/nautical-mile-knot.html
questions.q: What does a speed of one knot (kn) mean in navigation?
questions.fact: One knot means [[one nautical mile per hour]] in navigation.
questions.explain: A knot measures speed; a nautical mile measures distance. A distance in nautical miles is not the same as a speed in knots.

wrong.0: A nautical mile and a kilometre are different lengths.
wrong.2: The time interval is one hour, not one second.

questions.src: 국회도서관 독도 · 삼국접양지도 · https://dokdo.nanet.go.kr/dokdo/collection/collectionDetail.dokdo?collection_sid=1
questions.q: According to the National Assembly Library's description, how many maps accompany Sangoku Tsuran Zusetsu?
questions.fact: The National Assembly Library describes [[5 maps]] accompanying Sangoku Tsuran Zusetsu.
questions.explain: The well-known regional map associated with Dokdo is one of five accompanying maps. A famous individual sheet is not the entire map set.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전, 김유립 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0010079
questions.q: Which official investigated the possibility of settlement on Ulleungdo under King Uijong's orders in 1157?
questions.fact: [[Kim Yu-rip]] investigated settlement prospects on Ulleungdo in 1157 under King Uijong's orders.
questions.explain: Kim Yu-rip reported on the island's terrain and traces of settlements. Officials who surveyed Ulleungdo belonged to different historical periods.

questions.src: 한국어류학회지 · First Record of Gobiid Fish, Astrabe fasciata from Dokdo, Korea (2015) · https://koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO201511059258467.page
questions.q: What Korean name did a 2015 paper propose for Astrabe fasciata collected at Dokdo?
questions.fact: The 2015 paper proposed [[Dokdo-eolluk-mangduk (mottled goby)]] as the Korean name for Astrabe fasciata.
questions.explain: The paper reported a specimen from Dokdo as a first Korean record and proposed a Korean name. A first national record is not the description of a species new to science.

questions.src: Argo Program, Scripps Institution of Oceanography · How do floats work? · https://argo.ucsd.edu/how-do-floats-work/
questions.q: How does a typical Argo float adjust its ability to sink and rise?
choices: changing its volume to adjust buoyancy
raising itself with legs on the seabed
always being hauled up by a surface ship
questions.fact: A typical Argo float sinks and rises by [[changing its volume to adjust buoyancy]] in seawater.
questions.distractor: always being hauled up by a surface ship
questions.explain: A float changes volume and buoyancy, for example by moving oil into an external bladder. A ship does not haul it up by cable for every profile.
blankDistractors: raising itself with legs on the seabed
always being hauled up by a surface ship

wrong.0: Its rise is controlled through changes in buoyancy in seawater.
wrong.3: Argo floats do not profile through continual ship-based hauling.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전, 울릉 성인봉 원시림 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0029505 | 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전, 너도밤나무 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0012604
questions.q: Which Fagaceae tree is a characteristic species of the primeval forest on Seonginbong, Ulleungdo?
questions.fact: [[Neodobamnamu (Ulleungdo beech)]] is a characteristic Fagaceae tree of Seonginbong's primeval forest.
questions.explain: Seonginbong's forest includes stands of Neodobamnamu. A similar Korean name does not make it the same tree as Nadobamnamu.

questions.src: Argo Program, Scripps Institution of Oceanography · How do floats work? · https://argo.ucsd.edu/how-do-floats-work/
questions.q: What is the usual observation cycle of a standard Core Argo float?
questions.fact: A standard Core Argo float normally completes an observation cycle in [[10 days]] before repeating it.
questions.explain: A typical Core Argo float repeats its drift-and-profile cycle about every ten days. Specialized floats can use different cycle settings.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part VII · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part7.htm
questions.q: Under UNCLOS Article 92, how may a ship using multiple national flags according to convenience be treated?
choices: as automatically registered to the UN
as immune from responsibility in all waters
questions.fact: A ship using multiple flags according to convenience may be treated [[as a ship without nationality]] under Article 92.
questions.explain: Article 92(2) denies such a ship the ability to claim those nationalities against another state and permits treatment as stateless. This differs from a genuine lawful change of registry.
blankDistractors: as automatically registered to the UN
as immune from responsibility in all waters

wrong.1: The article does not guarantee simultaneous nationalities.
wrong.2: This does not automatically turn the vessel into a UN ship.

questions.src: NOAA · What is a thermocline? · https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/thermocline.html
questions.q: What is the defining feature of an ocean thermocline?
choices: constant wave height across the surface
a rapid temperature change with depth
questions.fact: A thermocline is defined by [[a rapid temperature change with depth]] in the water column.
questions.explain: A thermocline is a layer with a strong vertical temperature gradient. It does not mean a steep seabed or a particular wave height.
blankDistractors: constant wave height across the surface

wrong.2: Uniform salinity is not the definition of a thermocline.
wrong.3: This concerns water temperature structure, not seabed topography.

questions.src: 국회도서관 독도 · 독도 연표 2001년 이후 · https://dokdo.nanet.go.kr/dokdo/front.dokdo?menu=chronology_9
questions.q: Where on the mainland did KIOST open the East Sea–Dokdo exhibition hall in 2013?
questions.fact: KIOST opened the East Sea–Dokdo exhibition hall in [[Uljin]], on the mainland, in 2013.
questions.explain: The chronology records the January 24, 2013 opening at KIOST's East Sea research site in Uljin. Not every Dokdo exhibition facility is on an island.

questions.src: International Maritime Organization · Prevention of Pollution by Garbage from Ships · https://www.imo.org/en/ourwork/environment/pages/garbage-default.aspx
questions.q: Which garbage does MARPOL Annex V prohibit ships from routinely discharging at sea?
choices: food waste meeting permitted discharge conditions
non-harmful cargo residues meeting discharge conditions
permitted cleaning water not harmful to the sea
questions.fact: MARPOL Annex V prohibits routine discharge of [[plastic garbage]] from ships into the sea.
questions.distractor: food waste meeting permitted discharge conditions
questions.explain: Plastics are a key category covered by the discharge ban. The question concerns routine disposal, not regulated exceptions such as saving life at sea.
blankDistractors: food waste meeting permitted discharge conditions
non-harmful cargo residues meeting discharge conditions
permitted cleaning water not harmful to the sea

wrong.0: Food waste can be subject to conditional permission, unlike routine disposal of plastics.
wrong.2: Distinguish permitted cleaning water from plastic garbage.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 어류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=89
questions.q: Which submerged reef east of Seodo (West Islet) rises like a column from about 40 m to 8 m below the surface?
questions.fact: [[Gajicho]] is the submerged reef east of Seodo (West Islet) that rises from about 40 m to 8 m below the surface.
questions.explain: Important Dokdo landforms are not limited to rocks visible above water. The official fish-survey account describes Gajicho as a column-like submerged reef.

wrong.2: This confuses an island near Ulleungdo with a submerged Dokdo reef.

questions.src: 국제사법재판소 · La Cour, 구성 및 공용어 · https://www.icj-cij.org/fr/cour
questions.q: How many official languages does the International Court of Justice have?
questions.fact: The International Court of Justice uses [[2 languages]] as its official languages.
questions.explain: The Court's official languages are French and English. Do not confuse them with the UN's official languages or languages offered for selected website resources.

wrong.0: The Court does not have only English or only French as an official language.
wrong.2: This confuses the Court's official languages with those of the UN.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전, 성인봉 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0029504
questions.q: Which central volcanic cone formed through renewed eruption inside Ulleungdo's caldera?
questions.fact: [[Albong]] is the central cone formed by renewed volcanic activity inside Ulleungdo's caldera.
questions.explain: Albong formed inside the caldera after its formation. The island's highest peak and its central cone are not the same landform.

questions.src: 국립수산과학원 수산생명자원정보센터 · Ecklonia cava(감태) · https://www.nifs.go.kr/portal/bt/frctA/actionSpeciesSearchView.do?taxonId=10241 | KIOST Dokdo Research · Rocky-bottom ecosystem · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/eng/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=225
questions.q: Which brown seaweed is identified as Ecklonia cava in accounts of Dokdo's seaweed communities?
questions.fact: [[Gamtae (a brown kelp)]] is the Korean name for Ecklonia cava recorded in Dokdo's seaweed communities.
questions.explain: The National Institute of Fisheries Science identifies Ecklonia cava as Gamtae. Here the name refers to this brown kelp, not a green seaweed sometimes sold under the same name.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 중형저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=83
questions.q: How do agglutinated foraminiferans found in seabed studies form their shells?
choices: turning sunlight directly into a solid
questions.fact: Agglutinated foraminiferans build their shells by [[collecting and binding sediment grains]] from their surroundings.
questions.explain: The official guide distinguishes calcareous shells from those made of bound sediment particles. Foraminiferans do not all use the same shell-building material.
blankDistractors: turning sunlight directly into a solid

wrong.1: This does not mean inheriting another animal's skeleton.
wrong.2: The material described is sediment grains.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 독도의 자연환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=67
questions.q: In which year was Dokdo's AWS replaced by an automated synoptic observing system (ASOS)?
questions.fact: Dokdo's AWS was replaced by an ASOS in [[2009]], in December.
questions.explain: The official account dates the ASOS replacement to December 2009. Distinguish the initial automation from a later equipment replacement.

wrong.2: This is one year before the recorded replacement.
wrong.3: This is one year after the ASOS replacement.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part XVI · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part16.htm
questions.q: What does UNCLOS Article 300 require when states fulfil obligations and exercise rights?
choices: exemption from all duties on national-interest grounds
good-faith fulfilment and avoidance of abuse of rights
unlimited rights for the first state to act
questions.fact: Article 300 requires [[good-faith fulfilment and avoidance of abuse of rights]] under UNCLOS.
questions.distractor: unlimited rights for the first state to act
questions.explain: Possessing a right does not mean it may be exercised in any manner. The Convention requires good faith and rules out abuse of rights.
blankDistractors: exemption from all duties on national-interest grounds
unlimited rights for the first state to act

wrong.0: The principle regulates the exercise of rights rather than abolishing them.
wrong.1: The article does not waive every obligation on national-interest grounds.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS, Part VI · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part6.htm
questions.q: What defines sedentary species included in continental-shelf resources under UNCLOS Article 77?
choices: flying above the sea throughout life
free surface swimming without seabed contact
migration into land rivers for every breeding season
immobility or movement requiring constant seabed contact
questions.fact: Article 77 defines sedentary species by [[immobility or movement requiring constant seabed contact]] at the harvestable stage.
questions.distractor: free surface swimming without seabed contact
questions.explain: The definition concerns organisms immobile on or under the seabed, or unable to move without constant contact at the harvestable stage. It does not include every fish above the shelf.
blankDistractors: flying above the sea throughout life
free surface swimming without seabed contact
migration into land rivers for every breeding season

wrong.1: This does not match the constant-contact criterion for sedentary species.
wrong.2: The test concerns mobility and seabed contact at the harvestable stage, not breeding migration.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: What other name was formerly used for Chotdaebawi Rock on Dokdo?
questions.fact: [[Gwongchongbawi (Pistol Rock)]] is a former name for Chotdaebawi Rock on Dokdo.
questions.explain: Its shape inspired more than one name. Two names do not necessarily indicate two different rocks.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 투막집 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0059482
questions.q: What is the main purpose of the udegi surrounding a traditional Ulleungdo house?
questions.fact: The principal function of an udegi around the house is [[blocking snow, rain and wind]] in traditional Ulleungdo housing.
questions.explain: An udegi forms an outer screen beneath the eaves. It shelters the living space from harsh weather.

wrong.0: An udegi is an outer weather screen, not primarily a smoke vent.
wrong.2: Structural support and the screen's weather protection are different functions.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 울릉도학술조사대 보고기(3) · 홍종인 · 한성일보(1947.9.25) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part03_view05.jsp
questions.q: Who wrote the 1947 Hanseong Ilbo report on the Ulleungdo research expedition?
questions.fact: [[Hong Jong-in]] wrote the 1947 Hanseong Ilbo account of the Ulleungdo expedition.
questions.explain: The September 25 article names Hong Jong-in as its author. It describes sharing the findings through talks, exhibitions and a report.

wrong.1: A similar period does not make him the article's named author.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 육상생태계 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=68 | 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 참나리 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0055255
questions.q: Which plant found on Dokdo develops dark purplish bulbils in its leaf axils?
questions.fact: The [[tiger lily]] develops dark purplish bulbils in its leaf axils.
questions.explain: The bulbils can fall and grow into new plants. Leaf axils, not just flower color, help identify this species.

wrong.0: This aster is not the plant identified by those bulbils.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 칙령 제41호 관보 역문 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view03.jsp
questions.q: Under Article 3 of Imperial Edict No. 41, how many counties replaced the previous total of 26 in Gangwon-do?
questions.fact: The revised Gangwon-do county total was [[27 counties]] under Article 3 of Imperial Edict No. 41.
questions.explain: Adding Uldo County required revising the administrative count. This is a historical legal total, not today's count.

questions.src: 한국지형학회 · 황상일·박경근·윤순옥 · 독도 서도 북서 해안의 Holocene 기후변화와 타포니 지형발달(2009), 논문 초록 · https://www.dbpia.co.kr/Journal/articleDetail?nodeId=NODE09079686
questions.q: Which weathering process is discussed alongside waves in research on tafoni along Seodo (West Islet)?
questions.fact: The cited coastal-tafoni study identifies [[salt weathering]] as a process acting alongside waves.
questions.explain: The study discusses rock weathering influenced by seawater and salt. Tafoni are not volcanic vents.

wrong.0: This can cause weathering, but the cited tafoni study identifies salt weathering.
wrong.2: This confuses the cited coastal-tafoni explanation with dissolution landforms.

questions.src: 경상북도 울릉군 · 공공누리 · 안용복 장군 기념관(2016년 사진 설명) · https://www.kogl.or.kr/recommend/recommendDivView.do?division=img&recommendIdx=10376
questions.q: In which year did the An Yong-bok Memorial Hall on Ulleungdo open?
questions.fact: The An Yong-bok Memorial Hall opened in [[2013]] on Ulleungdo.
questions.explain: Ulleung County's description dates the opening to October 2013. A person's lifetime and a memorial's opening are different dates.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 증보문헌비고(1908) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view13.jsp
questions.q: What year is assigned to the Jeungbo Munheon Bigo containing the Uldo County passage in the foreign ministry's collection?
questions.fact: The foreign ministry dates this Jeungbo Munheon Bigo text to [[1908]] in its Dokdo collection.
questions.explain: The collection identifies the expanded work as a 1908 text. Distinguish it from the earlier Dongguk Munheon Bigo.

wrong.1: This is not the year assigned to the expanded work.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 원격탐사 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=98
questions.q: Which combination primarily explains Case-I seawater optics in the Dokdo remote-sensing account?
choices: land-derived sediment and dissolved organic matter
questions.fact: In the Dokdo account, [[seawater and phytoplankton]] primarily control Case-I seawater optics.
questions.distractor: land-derived sediment and dissolved organic matter
questions.explain: Case-I is a classification used to interpret ocean color. It does not establish that pollutants are entirely absent.
blankDistractors: land-derived sediment and dissolved organic matter

wrong.1: Strong independent terrestrial inputs are not the defining basis of the Case-I model.
wrong.2: Seabed signals differ from the optical properties of the water itself.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 유기오염물질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=79
questions.q: Why must grain size be considered when comparing PAH concentrations in sediments around Dokdo?
choices: PAHs occurring only in coarse grains
differences in adsorption on grain surfaces
grain size alone identifying the pollution source
complete PAH disappearance in fine grains
questions.fact: One reason to consider grain size in Dokdo PAH comparisons is [[differences in adsorption on grain surfaces]] in sediment.
questions.distractor: PAHs occurring only in coarse grains
questions.explain: Finer grains offer more surface area per unit mass for adsorption. A higher concentration alone does not locate a nearby source.
blankDistractors: PAHs occurring only in coarse grains
grain size alone identifying the pollution source
complete PAH disappearance in fine grains

wrong.0: Grain-size effects on adsorption do not mean that PAHs occur only in coarse grains.
wrong.2: Grain size is a factor to consider, not a sole determination of the emission source.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 수토역사전시관 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=110
questions.q: In which Ulleungdo village is the Ulleung Suto History Exhibition Hall?
questions.fact: The Ulleung Suto History Exhibition Hall is in [[Taeha-ri]] on Ulleungdo.
questions.explain: The hall in Taeha-ri presents the history and significance of suto inspections. It is separate from Dokdo Museum.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 별보 울릉도사황 · 황성신문(1899년 9월 23일) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view14.jsp
questions.q: What kind of trade exchanges goods for other goods in the 1899 Ulleungdo Sahwang account?
questions.fact: The 1899 account records [[barter]] as a way of exchanging goods on Ulleungdo.
questions.explain: The article describes goods being exchanged. It does not establish that every transaction on the island used this method.

wrong.0: Payment later is different from exchanging goods.
wrong.2: Competitive bidding is a different trading method.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 의정부 청의서(1900년 10월 22일) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view01.jsp
questions.q: To whom did Lee Geon-ha address the 1900 proposal to establish Uldo County?
questions.fact: [[Yun Yong-seon]] is the addressee of the October 22, 1900 proposal to establish Uldo County.
questions.explain: The sender and addressee are different people. The document runs from Interior Minister Lee Geon-ha to State Council head Yun Yong-seon.

wrong.1: He is not the addressee named on this proposal.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 암반생태계 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=87
questions.q: Which crab is cited as a subtropical crustacean recorded in Dokdo's rocky ecosystem?
questions.fact: The crab cited as a subtropical occurrence in the Dokdo account is the [[wrinkled xanthid crab]] in its crustacean examples.
questions.explain: The account records this crab around Dokdo. One species alone cannot quantify temperature change or establish its cause.

wrong.2: This confuses a deep-water fishery species with the cited coastal example.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 원격탐사 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=98
questions.q: How many observations per day are stated for first-generation GOCI in the Dokdo remote-sensing account?
questions.fact: The first-generation GOCI schedule in the Dokdo account provides [[8 observations]] per day.
questions.explain: This refers to the first-generation sensor described after the 2010 launch. Do not substitute the later GOCI-II schedule.

wrong.1: This is twice the first-generation count in the source.
wrong.3: A 24-hour day does not imply 24 observations.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 투막집 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0059482
questions.q: What is the basic construction method for the room walls of an Ulleungdo tumakjip?
questions.fact: The basic wall-building method of an Ulleungdo tumakjip is [[stacking interlocking logs]] at the corners.
questions.explain: Notched log ends interlock as the walls rise. The room wall is distinct from the surrounding udegi screen.

wrong.0: This is not interlocking log construction.
wrong.2: Even where mud is used, the basic wall structure is timber.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 한해통어지침(1903) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part06_view12.jsp
questions.q: Which 1903 Japanese fishing guide appears in the foreign ministry's Dokdo collection?
questions.fact: The foreign ministry's 1903 Japanese fishing guide is [[Hanhae Tong-eo Jichim]] in the Dokdo collection.
questions.explain: The 1903 guide describes the islands from a fishing perspective. Its purpose differs from sailing directions or a botanical survey.

wrong.1: This is a separate navigational publication.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 울릉도검찰일기 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0066658
questions.q: How long was Lee Gyu-won's on-island Ulleungdo inspection in 1882, according to the Korean encyclopedia?
questions.fact: The encyclopedia gives [[11 nights and 12 days]] for Lee Gyu-won's 1882 inspection on Ulleungdo.
questions.explain: The stay on the island is different from the full round trip from Seoul. Only the on-island inspection period is asked for.

wrong.2: This is one day shorter than the source's interval.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해양생태계모델링 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=86
questions.q: What is difficult to represent directly with only a one-dimensional vertical ecosystem model for Dokdo?
questions.fact: A one-dimensional vertical model cannot directly resolve [[horizontal movement of eddies]] across the Dokdo region.
questions.explain: A vertical model has limits in representing horizontal spatial change. The account describes three-dimensional information to complement it.

wrong.0: This can be represented along a vertical dimension.
wrong.1: A depth-dependent profile can be part of a vertical model.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 탄산염퇴적물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=97
questions.q: What is an important source material for carbonate sediments around Dokdo?
questions.fact: An important source of carbonate sediment around Dokdo is [[marine skeletons and shells]] deposited on the seabed.
questions.explain: Calcareous structures can break down into sediment. These particles have a different origin from volcanic rock fragments.

wrong.0: These are volcanic particles, not biogenic carbonate.
wrong.1: Quartz and calcium carbonate are different mineral materials.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 울릉도식물조사서(1919) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part06_view15.jsp
questions.q: What shape was distant Dokdo compared to in the 1919 Ulleungdo plant survey?
questions.fact: The 1919 plant survey compares distant Dokdo to [[an egg]] in shape.
questions.explain: The passage describes an egg-like island. It is a distant visual comparison, not a claim about the island's material.

wrong.1: The comparison is to an egg, not the moon.
wrong.3: The question asks for the text's comparison, not a geological structure.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 땅채송화(28쪽) · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=28&um=s
questions.q: Which succulent in the Dokdo plant guide has the scientific name Sedum oryzifolium?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide identifies Sedum oryzifolium as [[coastal stonecrop]] among its coastal plants.
questions.explain: It is a perennial stonecrop of coastal rocks. The guide describes succulent tissues and yellow flowers.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 동국여지지 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0016283
questions.q: Which scholar compiled Dongguk Yeojiji?
questions.fact: [[Yu Hyeong-won]] compiled Dongguk Yeojiji as a nationwide geography.
questions.explain: Yu compiled this work from regional geographical information. Do not confuse it with Dongguk Yeoji Seungnam.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 어류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=89
questions.q: Which fish was observed at Dokdo in 2008 and reported in a journal in 2014, according to the fish-survey account?
questions.fact: The Dokdo account dates observation of the [[bicolor chromis]] to 2008 and journal reporting to 2014.
questions.explain: The account distinguishes observation from publication. Publication year is not necessarily the year of arrival.

wrong.1: This is another fish listed separately in the account.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 공공데이터포털 · 독도대형갑각류(95종 수록 안내) · https://www.data.go.kr/data/15066893/fileData.do
questions.q: How many species are included in NIBR's guide to Dokdo's large crustaceans?
questions.fact: The NIBR guide to Dokdo's large crustaceans contains [[95 species]] in its coverage.
questions.explain: This asks about the guide's coverage. It is not a final count of all living species or all crustaceans on Dokdo.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 유기오염물질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=79
questions.q: What process brings pollutant-bearing dust onto the sea surface without rain in the Dokdo study?
questions.fact: Deposition of particles onto the sea surface without rain is [[dry deposition]] in the Dokdo account.
questions.explain: Pollutants attached to dust can enter the sea this way. It differs from removal by precipitation.

wrong.0: This involves precipitation such as rain or snow.
wrong.3: This starts at the seabed rather than in the atmosphere.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 만기요람 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0017551
questions.q: Who compiled Mangiyoram together with Sim Sang-gyu?
questions.fact: [[Seo Yeong-bo]] worked with Sim Sang-gyu in compiling Mangiyoram.
questions.explain: The royal commission assembled financial and military-administrative information. Its compilers and purpose provide context for its Dokdo-related passage.

questions.src: 국사편찬위원회 · 조선왕조실록 · 정조실록 40권, 정조 18년 6월 3일(1794), 울릉도 수토 결과 · https://sillok.history.go.kr/popup/print.do?gubun=kor&id=wva_11806003_009
questions.q: In Han Chang-guk's 1794 Ulleungdo inspection report, how many boats carried the provisions at departure?
questions.fact: The 1794 inspection report lists [[4 boats]] carrying provisions at departure.
questions.explain: Four boats departed together before bad weather separated them. Boats later seen are not the same count as the departing fleet.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · Shore Habitat · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/eng/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=226
questions.q: What must be aligned to compare the same real-world area in annual photographs of Dokdo's seaweed beds?
choices: the comparison site and image footprint
questions.fact: Spatial comparability of annual Dokdo seaweed-bed images requires matching [[the comparison site and image footprint]] between years.
questions.explain: The photographs must cover comparable space. A change in camera coverage must not be mistaken for ecological change.

wrong.1: Equal pixel counts do not guarantee equal areas on the ground.
wrong.2: The same place name can cover different image footprints.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 무기영양염류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=78
questions.q: In Dokdo water-column studies, which property changes sharply with depth across a nutricline?
questions.fact: A nutricline marks a sharp vertical change in [[nutrient concentration]] within the water column.
questions.explain: A nutricline and a thermocline can occur together. They refer to different measured properties.

wrong.0: A sharp temperature transition is a thermocline.
wrong.2: A salinity gradient is distinct from a nutrient gradient.

questions.src: 국사편찬위원회 · 조선왕조실록 · 정조실록 40권, 정조 18년 6월 3일(1794), 울릉도 수토 결과 · https://sillok.history.go.kr/popup/print.do?gubun=kor&id=wva_11806003_009
questions.q: How did Han Chang-guk's boats signal to one another in strong winds in 1794?
questions.fact: The 1794 Ulleungdo inspection report describes [[torches]] as signals between boats.
questions.explain: The report describes boats signaling with raised fires. Communication mattered during difficult crossings.

wrong.0: This passage describes fire signals, not flags.
wrong.1: The recorded signal was torchlight, not sound.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 닭의장풀·개밀 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=46&um=s
questions.q: Which annual plant in the Dokdo field guide has sky-blue summer flowers?
questions.fact: The Dokdo field guide describes [[Asiatic dayflower]] as an annual with sky-blue summer flowers.
questions.explain: The guide describes both its flowers and annual life cycle. Identification should also consider leaves and stems.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 별보 울릉도사황 · 황성신문(1899년 9월 23일) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view14.jsp
questions.q: Who is named as the 1883 assistant official for island development in the 1899 'Ulleungdo Sahwang'?
questions.fact: The 1899 account names [[Baek Chun-bae]] as the assistant official appointed in 1883.
questions.explain: The article names Kim Ok-gyun alongside Baek Chun-bae. It also discusses other administrators from different years.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 애꽃노린재·독도장님노린재 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=64&um=s
questions.q: Which insect in the Dokdo field guide is used as a natural enemy of thrips?
questions.fact: The Dokdo field guide identifies [[Orius sauteri]] as a natural enemy used against thrips.
questions.explain: Orius sauteri preys on small arthropods. Not every true bug is a plant pest.

wrong.0: The guide describes it mainly feeding on goosefoot-family plants.
wrong.3: The same guide describes it feeding on chrysanthemums and mugwort.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 원격탐사 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=98
questions.q: In which year was the first-generation GOCI ocean-color instrument launched?
questions.fact: The first-generation GOCI was launched in [[2010]] for ocean-color observations.
questions.explain: The Dokdo information system dates the first GOCI launch to 2010. Do not mix its specifications with those of later instruments.

wrong.1: This is ten years earlier than the stated launch.
wrong.3: The question concerns the first generation, not a later instrument.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024년) · 수중시각조사 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=12&um=s
questions.q: What is an advantage of underwater visual census (UVC) in Ulleungdo-Dokdo fish studies?
choices: a complete count even of unseen species
questions.fact: One advantage of underwater visual census is [[observation without capture]] during surveys.
questions.distractor: a complete count even of unseen species
questions.explain: Divers can survey fish without collecting every individual. Visibility and detectability still limit the observations.
blankDistractors: a complete count even of unseen species

wrong.0: The method does not detect every species outside the observer's view.
wrong.1: Avoiding capture does not remove the influence of visibility.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 어류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=89
questions.q: Which publication introducing Dokdo's underwater life was distributed to elementary schools in 2014?
choices: Geography of the Annals of King Sejong
questions.fact: [[Dokdo Underwater Ecological Map]] was distributed to elementary schools in 2014 to introduce underwater life.
questions.distractor: Geography of the Annals of King Sejong
questions.explain: The information system records the map's production and distribution. Survey results can support classroom learning as well as research.
blankDistractors: Geography of the Annals of King Sejong

questions.src: 국사편찬위원회 · 조선왕조실록 · 정조실록 40권, 정조 18년 6월 3일(1794), 울릉도 수토 결과 · https://sillok.history.go.kr/popup/print.do?gubun=kor&id=wva_11806003_009
questions.q: Which Wolsong commander conducted the Ulleungdo inspection reported in the Annals of King Jeongjo in 1794?
questions.fact: [[Han Chang-guk]] is the Wolsong commander named in the 1794 Ulleungdo inspection report.
questions.explain: The Gangwon governor relayed the inspection results of Han Chang-guk and his party. The reporting official and field inspector were not the same person.

wrong.0: His well-known Ulleungdo inspection dates to 1694, a century earlier.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024년) · 어류 확증표본 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=38&um=s
questions.q: Why are voucher specimens of Dokdo fish registered and preserved?
choices: an exact count of the field population
questions.fact: A preserved voucher specimen primarily provides [[evidence for rechecking species identification]] for researchers.
questions.distractor: an exact count of the field population
questions.explain: The report treats vouchers as scientific evidence for the species inventory. Registered specimens remain available for later examination.
blankDistractors: an exact count of the field population

wrong.0: The number of voucher specimens is not the total field population.
wrong.1: A registered specimen alone does not provide a lifetime movement record.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해조류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=90
questions.q: What DNA is synthesized from RNA information in gene-expression studies of Dokdo seaweeds?
questions.fact: Gene-expression studies synthesize [[complementary DNA (cDNA)]] from RNA information.
questions.explain: The seaweed research describes isolating RNA and synthesizing cDNA. This differs from naming DNA by its cellular location.

wrong.0: This names DNA by its organelle of origin.
wrong.2: Expressed RNA information is not the whole nuclear genome.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 후투티·칡때까치 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=138&um=s
questions.q: Which bird recorded during migration on Dokdo repeatedly raises and folds its crest?
questions.fact: The [[hoopoe]] is described in the Dokdo guide as raising and folding its crest.
questions.explain: Hoopoes have been observed during migration on Dokdo. A record there does not establish year-round residency.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 울릉 나리 너와 투막집과 억새 투막집 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0040439
questions.q: What are neowa, used on traditional roofs on Ulleungdo?
questions.fact: Neowa are [[split wooden roofing shingles]] used on traditional roofs.
questions.explain: Neowa are wooden roofing pieces. Their material differs from the grass thatch used on other log houses.

wrong.0: These are ceramic roof tiles, not neowa.
wrong.2: This confuses thatch with wooden shingles.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 홍재현 진술서(1947) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part06_view16.jsp | 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 어부 김윤삼의 증언 · 민국일보(1962) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part06_view17.jsp
questions.q: Whose 1947 statement in the foreign ministry archive describes Ulleungdo residents' knowledge of Dokdo?
questions.fact: [[Hong Jae-hyeon]] gave the 1947 statement about Ulleungdo residents' knowledge of Dokdo.
questions.explain: Hong Jae-hyeon's statement records local knowledge of Dokdo. Its speaker should not be confused with authors of survey reports.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 어류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=89
questions.q: What Korean name identifies Parioglossus dotui, whose 2019 Dokdo report is listed in the fish survey?
questions.fact: [[Kkoma-cheonghwang]] is the Korean name paired with Parioglossus dotui in the Dokdo fish material.
questions.explain: The system lists a published observation of this fish. A report date is not necessarily its first arrival at Dokdo.

wrong.1: This is a different fish in the same survey material.
wrong.2: This is not Parioglossus dotui.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해양생태계모델링 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=86
questions.q: In the Dokdo ecosystem-model description, what percentage of surface light marks the base of the euphotic zone?
questions.fact: The conventional lower euphotic boundary is where [[1%]] of surface light remains.
questions.explain: This is a light threshold, not a fixed depth in meters. Water clarity changes the depth at which it is reached.

wrong.3: This is above the conventional threshold asked about.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판 · 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: Why does appearing earlier in the Dokdo species checklist not mean a species is more abundant?
questions.fact: The revised Dokdo checklist applies [[taxonomy-based ordering]] in its species presentation.
questions.explain: The introduction explains taxonomic and alphabetical ordering. List position is not a population ranking.

wrong.0: The introduction explains a taxonomic arrangement, not a population ranking.
wrong.3: The species are not arranged solely by discovery date.

questions.src: 국사편찬위원회 · 조선왕조실록 · 정조실록 40권, 정조 18년 6월 3일(1794), 울릉도 수토 결과 · https://sillok.history.go.kr/popup/print.do?gubun=kor&id=wva_11806003_009
questions.q: At which Ulleungdo inlet did Han Chang-guk's party arrive, according to the 1794 inspection report?
questions.fact: The 1794 report names [[Hwangtogumi-jin]] as the party's arrival inlet on Ulleungdo.
questions.explain: The annals preserve both the voyage and landing place. Distinguish a mainland departure port from an island arrival point.

wrong.0: The question asks for the arrival point on Ulleungdo.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 동물플랑크톤 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=81
questions.q: What mesh size did the closing net use for depth-stratified zooplankton sampling around Dokdo in 2009–2018?
questions.fact: The 2009–2018 depth-stratified sampling used a mesh size of [[200 μm]] around Dokdo.
questions.explain: The method specifies a 200-micrometer closing net. Mesh size is not the diameter of the net opening.

wrong.2: This can be confused with the standard net used in 2006–2008.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 지형 및 지질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=66
questions.q: What process is recorded by bomb-sag structures in Dokdo's volcanic beds?
questions.fact: Bomb sags in Dokdo's deposits are interpreted as the result of [[impact by falling volcanic blocks]] during formation.
questions.explain: A large ejected rock can depress soft underlying beds. The sag preserves evidence of impact and deformation.

wrong.1: A bomb sag is impact deformation of a soft bed, not a cooling-contraction crack.
wrong.2: General compaction differs from localized impact deformation beneath a block.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 만기요람 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0017551
questions.q: What two broad areas of government are covered by Mangiyoram, which contains records of Usan and Ulleung?
questions.fact: Mangiyoram's two major sections concern [[finance and military affairs]] for government reference.
questions.explain: Its sections cover state finance and military administration. A book's purpose helps explain the context of its geographic records.

wrong.0: The inclusion of geographic information does not make these its two main sections.
wrong.2: This misidentifies the finance and military sections as diplomacy and ritual.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which rock south of Seodo (West Islet) is described as resembling a lowered trunk?
questions.fact: [[Kokkiribawi (Elephant Rock)]] forms an elephant-like outline by a sea cave south of Seodo (West Islet).
questions.explain: The name refers to an outline resembling a lowered trunk. Location matters because similar rock names occur on Ulleungdo.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2019) · 해조류·어류·무척추동물 머리말 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=68&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: What main type of visual material illustrates marine life in the 2019 Biodiversity of Dokdo volume?
questions.fact: The 2019 Dokdo marine-life volume primarily uses [[photographs of organisms]] to present species.
questions.explain: The volume presents seaweeds, fish and invertebrates in photographs. Its format differs from the earlier illustrated terrestrial-life volume.

wrong.0: Unlike an illustrated volume, this marine-life volume is presented as a photographic guide.
wrong.1: The main format is a photographic guide, not an atlas of species ranges.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 어부 김윤삼의 증언 · 민국일보(1962) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part06_view17.jsp
questions.q: Which fisherman is identified in the 1962 Minguk Ilbo testimony about Dokdo?
questions.fact: [[Kim Yun-sam]] is the fisherman identified in the 1962 Minguk Ilbo testimony about Dokdo.
questions.explain: The archive presents the newspaper account with Kim Yun-sam's testimony. Its publication date need not date every event he recalled.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 애꽃노린재·독도장님노린재 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=64&um=s
questions.q: Which insect does the Dokdo guide identify as Campylomma lividicorne, feeding on chrysanthemums and mugwort?
questions.fact: The name paired with Campylomma lividicorne is [[Dokdo-jangnim-norinjae]] in the Dokdo insect guide.
questions.explain: The guide describes its coloration, antennae and host plants. A Dokdo name does not by itself establish endemism.

wrong.2: This is a different predatory bug in the same guide.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 유기오염물질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=79 | 국제도량형국(BIPM) · nano 접두어 · https://www.bipm.org/en/committees/cg/cgpm/11-1960/resolution-12
questions.q: In Dokdo sediment-pollutant measurements, how many grams equal one nanogram (ng)?
questions.fact: One nanogram equals [[0.000000001 g]] in sediment-concentration measurements.
questions.explain: Nano means one billionth. Understanding the numerator's mass unit helps interpret concentrations such as ng/g.

wrong.0: This is one milligram.
wrong.1: This is one microgram.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 동물플랑크톤 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=81
questions.q: What should be checked when comparing Dokdo plankton counts obtained with different net meshes?
choices: only identical species richness between periods
only differences in official name spelling
questions.fact: Comparisons between plankton samples taken with different meshes should consider [[capture efficiency and organism-size range]] when evaluating method-related bias.
questions.distractor: only identical species richness between periods
questions.explain: The survey describes different mesh specifications across periods. Method changes must be considered alongside environmental changes.
blankDistractors: only identical species richness between periods
only differences in official name spelling

wrong.1: The observations alone do not establish a single cause.
wrong.2: Different meshes may retain small organisms differently.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 별보 울릉도사황 · 황성신문(1899년 9월 23일) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view14.jsp
questions.q: Which island resident does the 1899 'Ulleungdo Sahwang' say was appointed Wolsong commander in 1888?
questions.fact: [[Seo Gyeong-su]] is the resident named for the 1888 Wolsong appointment in the 1899 account.
questions.explain: The account links him to settlement and foreign logging problems. His role predates the island supervisor Bae Gye-ju discussed later.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판 · 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: Which year of the National Species List underlies the taxonomy and names in the revised Dokdo checklist?
questions.fact: The revised Dokdo checklist cites the [[2019]] National Species List for taxonomy and names.
questions.explain: A study year can differ from the date of its taxonomic reference. Name comparisons should account for the edition used.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해저퇴적환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=96
questions.q: Which isotope ratio in foraminiferal shells does the Dokdo information system describe as a clue to past conditions?
questions.fact: The Dokdo sediment account specifically names the [[oxygen-isotope ratio]] in foraminiferal shells as an environmental clue.
questions.explain: Isotope analysis helps interpret environmental information in sediments. The ratio should not be treated as responding only to temperature.

wrong.0: Other isotopes can be studied, but the cited Dokdo sediment account specifies oxygen.
wrong.1: The question asks which analysis is named in this source, not all possible isotope studies.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 무기영양염류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=78
questions.q: Which is a nitrogen-based nutrient measured in the inorganic-nutrient survey around Dokdo?
questions.fact: The named nitrogen-based nutrient measurements include [[nitrate and nitrite]] in the Dokdo survey.
questions.explain: These compounds supply nitrogen, while phosphate and silicate concern other elements. Nutrient categories should not be conflated.

wrong.0: This is the phosphorus-based nutrient category.
wrong.1: This is a silicon-based nutrient, not a nitrogen-based one.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which named reef is described as being at the northern end of Dokdo?
questions.fact: [[Bukhyangcho Reef]] is described as a reef at the northern end of Dokdo.
questions.explain: The place-name list includes reefs as well as exposed rocks. An outline map alone may omit such features.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 동물플랑크톤 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=81
questions.q: What role do zooplankton play between phytoplankton and fish in Dokdo's marine food web?
choices: transferring energy backward from fish to plants
questions.fact: Zooplankton's role between phytoplankton and fish is [[transfer of food energy]] in this food-web link.
questions.explain: Phytoplankton production can pass through zooplankton to fish. Small organisms can provide a major food-web connection.
blankDistractors: transferring energy backward from fish to plants

wrong.0: Phytoplankton are the photosynthetic primary producers in this link.
wrong.2: Zooplankton's role cannot be reduced to decomposition alone.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 조선국교제시말내탐서(1870) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part05_view02.jsp
questions.q: Who reported alongside Moriyama Shigeru and Saito Sakae in the 1870 confidential report on relations with Joseon?
questions.fact: [[Sada Hakubo]] was one of the named reporters of the 1870 confidential account on relations with Joseon.
questions.explain: The archived document lists its reporters. This question concerns authorship, not a new interpretation of its territorial statements.

wrong.0: He is associated with the 1667 Onshu Shicho Goki.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 어류 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=89
questions.q: Which midwater fish is described around Dokdo's Gajicho together with rosefish?
questions.fact: The Dokdo fish account lists the [[Pacific pomfret]] as a midwater fish around Gajicho.
questions.explain: The survey describes fish observed in midwater around Gajicho. Dokdo's fish fauna is not limited to bottom-associated species.

wrong.1: This is a different fish from Pacific pomfret.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 동물플랑크톤 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=81
questions.q: Using the density calculation employed in plankton surveys, what is the density of 250 individuals in 5 m³?
questions.fact: A hypothetical sample with 250 individuals in 5 m³ has a density of [[50 individuals/m³]] by division.
questions.explain: Divide the count by the sampled water volume. These are hypothetical exercise values, not measured Dokdo data.

wrong.2: This leaves the total count undivided by volume.
wrong.3: This multiplies by volume instead of dividing.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해저지형 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=93
questions.q: What shape distinguishes An Yong-bok Seamount from the flat-topped Sim Heung-taek and Isabu seamounts?
questions.fact: An Yong-bok Seamount is described as [[conical]] in the Dokdo seafloor account.
questions.explain: Nearby seamounts do not all share one summit form. The source contrasts this cone with flatter summits elsewhere.

wrong.0: This is the form associated with Sim Heung-taek and Isabu seamounts.
wrong.3: A seamount is raised relief, not a deep trench.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 뱃멀미와 김연덕 독도행각 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0040 | 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 학술조사 준비물 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0020
questions.q: Which diary by Kim Yeon-deok records the voyage and seasickness of the 1953 Ulleungdo-Dokdo expedition?
questions.fact: [[Dokdo Haenggak]] is Kim Yeon-deok's diary of the 1953 expedition journey.
questions.explain: A personal diary preserves experiences absent from formal plans. The collection highlights its descriptions of the crossing and seasickness.

wrong.1: This confuses the diary with Lee Gyu-won's 1882 account.
wrong.3: This is a historical account by a different author.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해저지형 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=93
questions.q: Approximately how high is the Dokdo volcanic edifice above the seabed, according to the information system?
questions.fact: The Dokdo volcanic edifice is described as rising about [[2300 m]] above the seabed.
questions.explain: Summit elevation above sea level differs from total height above the seabed. The visible islets form only part of the edifice.

wrong.2: Distinguish this from the nearby deep-gap water depth.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 울릉도검찰일기 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0066658
questions.q: What does 'manuscript copy' mean for the bibliographic form of the Ulleungdo Inspection Diary?
choices: a book printed with metal type
a book made from photographic prints
questions.fact: The Ulleungdo Inspection Diary's manuscript format means it is [[a book written by hand]] in its physical production.
questions.explain: The bibliographic entry identifies one manuscript volume. Its mode of recording and transmission also matters.
blankDistractors: a book printed with metal type
a book made from photographic prints

wrong.1: A handwritten manuscript is not a woodblock print.
wrong.2: This confuses movable-type printing with handwriting.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판 · 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: What does the first Dokdo record of a species already known in Korea establish by itself?
choices: confirmation of a species new to science
a new occurrence record for Dokdo
confirmation of arrival in that year
questions.fact: By itself, the first Dokdo record of a species already known in Korea establishes [[a new occurrence record for Dokdo]] for that species.
questions.distractor: confirmation of a species new to science
questions.explain: The checklist distinguishes new local records of known species. A first local record is not the same as a species new to science.
blankDistractors: confirmation of a species new to science
confirmation of arrival in that year

wrong.0: The species may already be known elsewhere.
wrong.2: Occurrence on Dokdo does not establish exclusive distribution.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 꼬까도요·괭이갈매기 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=130&um=s
questions.q: Which shorebird is listed as Arenaria interpres in the Dokdo bird guide?
questions.fact: The [[ruddy turnstone]] is listed as Arenaria interpres in the Dokdo bird guide.
questions.explain: The guide describes its plumage and short legs. Migrating shorebirds also appear in records from Dokdo.

questions.src: 대한민국 외교부 독도 자료실 · 부산영사관 보고서(1902) · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part06_view11.jsp
questions.q: What reason did the 1902 Busan Ilbo account give for abalone fishers returning from Dokdo after several days?
choices: a shortage of salt for transport
a shortage of containers for abalone
questions.fact: The 1902 account identifies [[a shortage of drinking water]] as the reason for returning from Dokdo.
questions.distractor: a shortage of salt for transport
questions.explain: The fishing account describes difficulties obtaining drinking water. Continuing work requires supplies as well as access to resources.
blankDistractors: a shortage of salt for transport
a shortage of containers for abalone

wrong.0: The account links the short stay to drinking water, not salt.
wrong.1: The question concerns the recorded reason for return, not workforce size.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 학술조사 분야와 조사단 구성 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0003_0010
questions.q: Which folklorist is listed as leader in the 1947 first Ulleungdo expedition roster?
questions.fact: [[Song Seok-ha]] is listed as leader in the 1947 first Ulleungdo expedition roster.
questions.explain: The collection lists Song Seok-ha as leader and two deputy leaders. This question concerns those recorded roles.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 암반생태계 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=87 | 국립생물자원관 · 한국의 무척추동물 제21권 6호: 만각류, 분류군 목록 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=253&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=8&um=s
questions.q: What Korean name identifies Pollicipes mitella in Dokdo's rocky-shore fauna?
questions.fact: The animal named Pollicipes mitella is [[Geobukson (stalked barnacle)]] in Dokdo's rocky-shore account.
questions.explain: Despite a shell-like appearance, it is a crustacean related to barnacles. An external covering alone does not make an animal a mollusk.

wrong.0: Mussels are mollusks, not the named species.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 울릉 나리 너와 투막집과 억새 투막집 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0040439 | 국가유산청 · 국가유산포털 · 울릉 나리 억새 투막집 · https://www.heritage.go.kr/heri/cul/culSelectDetail.do?ccbaCpno=1483702570000&pageNo=1_1_1_1&sngl=Y
questions.q: In which year were the neowa- and grass-roofed log houses at Nari, Ulleungdo, designated as national folk heritage?
questions.fact: The Nari log houses received national folk-heritage designation in [[2007]], according to the heritage record.
questions.explain: The recorded designation date is December 31, 2007. That is not necessarily the construction year or the start of island settlement.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024년) · 수중조사 방법 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=16&um=s
questions.q: What site-level information did the 2024 Ulleungdo-Dokdo fish report present because quantitative methods were not yet sufficient?
questions.fact: The 2024 report presents [[species-composition data]] while acknowledging limits to quantitative assessment.
questions.explain: The report focuses on which species occurred. A species list is not a definitive estimate of total fish resources.

wrong.0: The report presents the species composition, not catch weights.
wrong.1: Observations cannot simply be presented as an exact total population.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 암반생태계 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=87 | 오답 국명 확인: 국립생물자원관 · 국가생물종목록 2권 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=21&callmode=normal&eclang=ko&start=214&um=s
questions.q: What Korean name is given to the subtropical coral Dendrophyllia cribrosa recorded around Dokdo?
questions.fact: The name used for Dendrophyllia cribrosa is [[Yuchak-namudolsanho]] in the Dokdo rocky-shore account.
questions.explain: The account lists it among subtropical organisms observed near Dokdo. One coral record alone does not establish a climate shift for the entire sea.

wrong.2: Despite its name, this is an alga rather than a coral animal.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 발간사(2024.2) · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/information.do
questions.q: In which year did the Joseon Alpine Club, which organized island expeditions, become the Korean Alpine Club?
questions.fact: The Joseon Alpine Club adopted the Korean Alpine Club name in [[1948]], according to the collection.
questions.explain: The collection distinguishes founding from renaming. This explains why the earlier name is used for the 1947 expedition.

wrong.0: This confuses the founding year with the renaming year.
wrong.2: The first island expedition and the renaming are separate events.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 학술조사 분야와 조사단 구성 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0003_0010
questions.q: Why does the climbing team's absence from the 1953 planned roster not prove that it did not participate?
choices: the completeness of every planned roster
an exact match between plans and activities
automatic use of another year's roster
questions.fact: The 1953 climbing team's attendance is supported by [[participation evidence in other records]] despite omission from the planned roster.
questions.distractor: the completeness of every planned roster
questions.explain: The collection separately establishes the participation of the omitted team. Plans and actual events must be compared across records.
blankDistractors: the completeness of every planned roster
an exact match between plans and activities
automatic use of another year's roster

wrong.0: The source compares actual participation records with omissions in the plan.
wrong.1: A plan does not guarantee an identical record of actual attendance.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 심해탐사 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=84
questions.q: What do ripple marks on the sandy bottom indicate in the Dokdo underwater exploration account?
choices: contraction marks from cooling volcanic rock
questions.fact: Sandy-bottom ripples near Dokdo are interpreted as [[sand rearranged by moving water]] in the seafloor account.
questions.distractor: contraction marks from cooling volcanic rock
questions.explain: Waves or currents can move sand into ripples. The question concerns their formation, not an exact flow-speed estimate.
blankDistractors: contraction marks from cooling volcanic rock

wrong.0: Ripples form through sand movement, not contraction cracks in cooling rock.
wrong.1: This confuses a rippled sediment surface with fault displacement.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 갯까치수염 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=26&um=s
questions.q: Which coastal plant is listed as Lysimachia mauritiana in the Dokdo plant guide?
questions.fact: The name paired with Lysimachia mauritiana is [[seaside loosestrife]] in the Dokdo plant guide.
questions.explain: The guide describes a coastal biennial. Plants with similar coastal names can have very different leaves and flowers.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 본격적으로 독도를 조사하다 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0003
questions.q: What service did the medical members of the post-liberation island expeditions provide to Ulleungdo residents?
questions.fact: The recorded activity of medical expedition members was [[free medical care]] for Ulleungdo residents.
questions.explain: The collection describes medical research and free care in island villages. The expedition was not limited to rocks, plants and animals.

wrong.0: The direct support described in the source is medical care.
wrong.3: Providing care on an expedition differs from issuing professional licenses.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 판권 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=170&um=s
