questions.q: Who created the scientific illustrations for the 2017 terrestrial plants, insects and birds volume of Biodiversity of Dokdo?
questions.fact: [[Kim Yun-gyeong]] is credited with the illustrations in the 2017 Dokdo terrestrial-life volume.
questions.explain: Illustrations help readers examine identifying features. The volume credits the illustrator as well as the researchers.

wrong.0: He was a nineteenth-century mapmaker, not this illustrator.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 울릉 나리 너와 투막집과 억새 투막집 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0040439
questions.q: Which vine is described as a binding material in the traditional construction of Nari log houses on Ulleungdo?
questions.fact: The binding material in the Nari house account is identified as [[kudzu vine]] in its construction.
questions.explain: The construction used locally available materials. Traditional joints should not be imagined only in terms of modern metal fittings.

wrong.1: The binding material named in this account is kudzu vine.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판 · 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: How many species are recorded in the revised Dokdo checklist incorporating the 2022 survey?
questions.fact: The revised checklist incorporating the 2022 survey records [[2134 species]] in its inventory.
questions.explain: This is the inventory count in that edition. It is not a present-day census of every living species or individual.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 독도 섬효과 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=82
questions.q: In research on the waters around Dokdo, what does 'oligotrophic' indicate?
questions.fact: Oligotrophic waters have relatively low levels of [[available nutrients]] to support production.
questions.explain: The term describes nutrient conditions. It does not mean that no fish exist or that the water is necessarily polluted.

wrong.0: Oxygen depletion and low nutrient availability are different conditions.
wrong.2: Low salinity is not the meaning of oligotrophy.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 학술조사 분야와 조사단 구성 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0003_0010
questions.q: Which entomologist known for butterfly research is listed as head of Biology Team A in the 1947 expedition roster?
questions.fact: [[Seok Joo-myung]] is listed as head of Biology Team A in the 1947 expedition roster.
questions.explain: The collection identifies Seok Joo-myung as an entomologist and butterfly researcher. Different specialties had distinct roster roles.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전 · 동국여지지 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0016283
questions.q: Which year does the Academy of Korean Studies give for Yu Hyeong-won's compilation of Dongguk Yeojiji?
questions.fact: Yu Hyeong-won compiled Dongguk Yeojiji in [[1656]], according to the encyclopedia.
questions.explain: A compilation date matters when comparing geographic records. Similar book titles do not imply the same historical period.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 독도 섬효과 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=82 | 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해양생태계모델링 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=86
questions.q: Which physical properties are commonly examined together to distinguish water masses near Dokdo?
questions.fact: The Dokdo account defines water masses using [[temperature and salinity]] as its basic pair of physical properties.
questions.explain: Mixing changes the distribution of water properties. A water mass is not a fixed administrative area drawn on a map.

wrong.1: Other measurements can help, but the defining pair in this account is temperature and salinity.
wrong.3: Wave properties differ from the key physical properties defining water masses.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해양생태계모델링 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=86
questions.q: Which range of processes does biogeochemical cycling in the Dokdo ecosystem model encompass?
questions.fact: The scope of biogeochemical cycling includes [[biological, geological and chemical processes]] in the ecosystem account.
questions.explain: Models connect the movement and transformation of elements such as carbon and nitrogen. Physical transport and biological activity interact.

wrong.0: The concept includes biological use, chemical transformation and reservoir exchange, not transport alone.
wrong.2: Biological processes alone do not describe the whole cycle.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 칠성무당벌레·무당벌레 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=82&um=s
questions.q: Which Dokdo-guide insect, Harmonia axyridis, is described as having highly variable markings?
questions.fact: The Dokdo insect guide pairs Harmonia axyridis with the name [[harlequin ladybird]] in its species account.
questions.explain: One species can show several color patterns. A pattern difference alone does not always mean a different species.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판 · 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: How does the revised Dokdo checklist handle records with uncertain occurrence?
choices: classification of all as newly discovered species
questions.fact: The revised checklist uses [[separation into a distinct list]] for uncertain occurrence records.
questions.explain: The introduction states that uncertain records are listed separately. This preserves differences in evidential confidence.
blankDistractors: classification of all as newly discovered species

wrong.0: This contradicts the purpose of separating uncertain records.
wrong.1: Insufficient confirmation does not establish extinction.

questions.src: 외교부 · 대구시보 기사(1947.6.20) 역문 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part03_view10.jsp
questions.q: Which Gyeongbuk governor did Daegu Sibo report as forwarding Dokdo evidence to the central authorities in June 1947?
questions.fact: [[Choi Hee-song]] is the governor named in the June 1947 report about forwarding Dokdo evidence.
questions.explain: The article reports the forwarding of locally preserved evidence. The transmitting official need not be the original document's author.

wrong.3: This confuses a 1906 county report with the 1947 governor's action.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which Dokdo rock is described as resembling an open fan when viewed from the southwest?
questions.fact: [[Buchaebawi]] is the Dokdo rock described as fan-shaped when viewed from the southwest.
questions.explain: A shape-based name can depend on viewing direction. It need not have the same outline from every side.

wrong.0: This is a different feature named for traditional headwear.
wrong.3: This is not the fan-shaped rock in the account.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024년) · 수중조사 방법 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=16&um=s
questions.q: What is the area of a 30 m by 5 m survey belt, as used in the underwater fish-survey method?
questions.fact: A rectangular survey belt measuring 30 m by 5 m covers [[150 m²]] in area.
questions.explain: Multiply length by width: 30 times 5. Survey area matters when comparing observations from different spatial extents.

wrong.1: This adds length and width rather than multiplying them.
wrong.3: This confuses perimeter with area.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 지형 및 지질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=66
questions.q: What does 'residual soil' mean in the description of Dokdo's soils?
choices: soil deposited by a large river
soil carried from afar by wind
soil remaining from weathering of rock in place
questions.fact: The residual soil described for Dokdo is [[soil remaining from weathering of rock in place]] according to the geological account.
questions.distractor: soil deposited by a large river
questions.explain: The source describes soil formed by weathering on the island. The term distinguishes local formation from transport and deposition.
blankDistractors: soil deposited by a large river
soil carried from afar by wind

wrong.0: Transported alluvial soil differs from residual soil.
wrong.2: This describes wind-transported material instead.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사를 가다 · 학술조사 분야와 조사단 구성 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0003_0010
questions.q: Which geology-team leader published a preliminary geological report on Ulleungdo and Dokdo after the first expedition?
questions.fact: [[Ok Seung-sik]] published the preliminary geological account after the first island expedition.
questions.explain: The collection identifies him with geology and mineralogy. This role differs from the animal, medical and social-science teams.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 독도종합정보시스템 · 해저지형 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=93
questions.q: Which year labels the additionally identified small submarine crater in the Dokdo seafloor account?
questions.fact: The seafloor account labels the additional small-crater identification with the year [[2018]] in its caption.
questions.explain: An identification date is not an eruption date. The question concerns when an existing feature was recognized through surveying.

wrong.3: This differs from the date given in the caption.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024년) · 수중조사 방법 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=16&um=s
questions.q: Why did the 2024 fish survey examine rock crevices, sand and seaweed beyond the fixed survey belt?
choices: converting observations to a whole-area population
additional detection of fish in microhabitats
questions.fact: Examining crevices and seaweed supports [[additional detection of fish in microhabitats]] beyond the main survey belt.
questions.explain: Some fish may be missed in general observations. The report describes extra checks of these habitats during remaining dive time.
blankDistractors: converting observations to a whole-area population

wrong.0: The additional observations serve a different purpose from remeasuring the fixed belt.
wrong.1: Qualitative searches do not establish an exact population for the whole area.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024년) · 수중조사 방법 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=16&um=s
questions.q: If a fish species is not seen in one underwater survey of Dokdo, what is the most defensible record?
questions.fact: One unsuccessful underwater sighting attempt establishes [[non-detection under the survey conditions]] for the species.
questions.explain: Survey coverage, timing and habitat affect detection. A non-detection is not automatically proof of absence.

wrong.0: A single non-detection does not establish local extinction.
wrong.2: One survey does not automatically invalidate earlier records.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which Dokdo rock resembles a chicken when viewed from the residents' quarters on Seodo (West Islet)?
questions.fact: [[Dalkbawi Rock]] is described as resembling a chicken from the residents' quarters on Seodo (West Islet).
questions.explain: A rock name may reflect its appearance from a particular direction. The viewing position is part of the description.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 6–7쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=6&um=s
questions.q: What kind of island is Dokdo when described as never having been connected to a continent?
questions.fact: Dokdo is [[an oceanic island]] that has never been joined to a continent.
questions.explain: This distinction concerns a past connection to a continent. Distance from the mainland alone does not define it.

wrong.0: This conflicts with the stated absence of a continental connection.
wrong.2: This would mean a human-built island.

questions.src: 외교부 독도 · 울도군 설치 청의서, 1900년 10월 22일 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view01.jsp
questions.q: Which year does the 1900 proposal for Uldo County give for the establishment of the island inspector's office?
questions.fact: The Uldo County proposal dates the establishment of the island inspector's office to [[1895]] in its retrospective account.
questions.explain: The proposal uses the era year Gaeguk 504, corresponding to 1895. The inspector's office predates the county proposal.

wrong.1: This year is later than the proposal itself.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 30–31쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=30&um=s
questions.q: Which woody climber in the Dokdo field guide flowers in autumn and ripens its fruit the following spring?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide describes [[broad-leaved oleaster]] as a woody climber flowering in autumn and fruiting the following spring.
questions.explain: Its flowering and fruiting span two calendar years. The guide describes a seasonal cycle rather than simultaneous flowers and ripe fruit.

wrong.0: This is a different climbing plant in the guide.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지질환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=95 | 황상구·전영권 · 독도 화산의 분출윤회와 화산형태 (2003), 자원환경지질 36(6) · https://www.koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO200311922118921.pub?lang=ko
questions.q: At least how many eruption cycles does the 2003 Dokdo geology study infer?
questions.fact: The 2003 study uses [[three cycles]] as its inferred lower bound for eruptions above sea level at Dokdo.
questions.explain: The 2003 paper infers at least three cycles. This is not a claim that exactly three individual eruptions occurred.

wrong.1: The source does not interpret only one cycle.

questions.src: 독도재단 · 독도의 지질 · https://k-dokdo.com/index.do?menu_id=00010085
questions.q: What process leaves a resistant rock pillar when softer surrounding rock on Dokdo wears away faster?
questions.fact: The process called [[differential erosion]] can leave resistant parts of Dokdo's rocks standing after weaker material wears away.
questions.explain: Different rocks need not erode at the same rate. Differences in resistance help shape the remnants.

wrong.0: The question is not about material deposited by glaciers.
wrong.3: This differs from sediment accumulating at a river mouth.

questions.src: 외교부 독도 · 울도군 설치 청의서, 1900년 10월 22일 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view01.jsp
questions.q: Which Interior Minister submitted the proposal to establish Uldo County on October 22, 1900?
questions.fact: [[Yi Geon-ha]] submitted the 1900 Uldo County proposal as Interior Minister.
questions.explain: The sender and recipient were different officials. Separating investigators, authors and recipients clarifies the administrative process.

questions.src: 외교부 독도 · 오하기문 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/m/kor/pds/part02_view10.jsp | 한국학중앙연구원 · 오하기문 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0038591
questions.q: Which work by Hwang Hyeon does the foreign ministry present separately from Maecheon Yarok for a 1906 Dokdo account?
questions.fact: The foreign ministry presents [[Ohagimun]] as a separate work containing Hwang Hyeon's 1906 Dokdo account.
questions.explain: Works by the same author still need distinct titles. Naming only the author does not identify the cited record.

wrong.0: This is Woo Yong-jeong's survey account, not the work asked about.
wrong.1: This should be distinguished from Yi Gyu-won's inspection diary.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지질환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=95
questions.q: Which interaction does the account of Dokdo's hydrovolcanic deposits link to explosive activity?
questions.fact: The interpretation of Dokdo's submarine eruptions links explosive fragmentation to [[interaction between water and magma]] during eruption.
questions.explain: Contact with seawater can affect how an eruption proceeds. Not every volcanic layer formed from quietly flowing lava.

wrong.1: This does not explain the production of volcanic fragments.
wrong.3: This confuses weathering of existing rock with eruption processes.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 및 주변 해역 생물종 조사(2024) · 28–29쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=28&um=s
questions.q: In a Dokdo fish survey, what does occurrence at 19 of 25 stations directly describe?
choices: the breeding rate of the entire area
questions.fact: The ratio of occupied survey stations to all surveyed stations expresses [[frequency of occurrence across stations]] for a fish species.
questions.explain: Being found at many stations is not the same as having many individuals. Occurrence and abundance measure different things.
blankDistractors: the breeding rate of the entire area

wrong.0: This ratio does not state how many individuals were at each station.
wrong.3: Occurrence data alone do not measure breeding success.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which Dokdo rock name comes from a type of seaweed harvested there?
questions.fact: The Dokdo place-name account links [[Miyeokbawi Rock]] to sea-mustard harvesting.
questions.explain: Rock names can preserve fishing work as well as shapes. Sea mustard and laver are distinct resources in these names.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 학술조사의 예산 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0030
questions.q: Can a planned amount in the 1952 Dokdo expedition budget be reported as the amount actually spent?
choices: the planned amount is the actual spending
registration fees are the entire budget
donated supplies are unrelated to costs
the plan must be distinguished from final accounts
questions.fact: When reading the 1952 expedition budget, [[the plan must be distinguished from final accounts]] to avoid overstating what the document proves.
questions.distractor: the planned amount is the actual spending
questions.explain: A budget proposal records expectations at the planning stage. Actual attendance and spending need separate evidence.
blankDistractors: the planned amount is the actual spending
registration fees are the entire budget
donated supplies are unrelated to costs

wrong.0: This is a proposal, not receipts or final accounts.
wrong.1: Other funding and in-kind support must also be considered.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 한국산악회의 창립 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0001_0010
questions.q: In which year was the Corean Alpine Club founded before organizing post-liberation Ulleungdo–Dokdo expeditions?
questions.fact: The Northeast Asian History Foundation dates the club's founding to [[1945]] in its institutional history.
questions.explain: The club was established just after liberation. Its founding and later change of name are separate events.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 158–159쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=158&um=s
questions.q: Which bird in the Dokdo guide uses crossed bill tips to extract conifer seeds?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide describes [[red crossbill]] as using crossed bill tips to extract conifer seeds.
questions.explain: Bill shape relates to how food is handled. Inclusion among Dokdo observations does not establish breeding there.

wrong.0: This does not match the crossed-bill description.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 2–3쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: How many representative species are illustrated in the 2017 Dokdo guide to plants, insects and birds?
questions.fact: The 2017 Dokdo illustrated guide presents [[150 species]] as representative plants, insects and birds.
questions.explain: The number selected for an illustrated guide is not the total biodiversity of Dokdo. Check what the book includes.

wrong.0: This can confuse one section with all three combined.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도 해양생물자원의 활용 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=91
questions.q: What is a crude extract before purification in research on Dokdo marine organisms?
choices: a pure substance confirmed as one compound
an extract containing a mixture of components
questions.fact: A crude extract in Dokdo bioresource research is [[an extract containing a mixture of components]] before separation and purification.
questions.distractor: a pure substance confirmed as one compound
questions.explain: Separation and structural identification still follow extraction. Obtaining an extract does not mean isolating one particular compound.
blankDistractors: a pure substance confirmed as one compound

wrong.0: A single compound must be established through separation and analysis.
wrong.2: A research sample is not an approved product.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 한국산악회의 창립 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0001_0010
questions.q: Which island did the Corean Alpine Club survey in 1946, before its 1947 Ulleungdo–Dokdo expedition?
questions.fact: [[Jeju]] was the island studied in the club's first national-land investigation in 1946.
questions.explain: The Ulleungdo–Dokdo expedition followed a wider program of studying the land. Its institutional background extends beyond one island.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 우리나라 지도에 나타난 독도 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/dokdo/item/level.do?levelId=eddok.d_0004_0060_0010
questions.q: Who made Dongguk Daejido, as presented in the Northeast Asian History Foundation's Dokdo materials?
questions.fact: [[Jeong Sang-gi]] made Dongguk Daejido, a map discussed in the foundation's Dokdo materials.
questions.explain: Maps with similar titles need not share an author. Check the title, maker and surviving version together.

wrong.0: This confuses the maker with that of Daedong Yeojido.
wrong.2: This is not Kim Dae-geon's Joseon Jeondo.

questions.src: 국가기록원 · 대한전도 · https://theme.archives.go.kr/next/dokdo/primaryList12.do
questions.q: What cannot be established solely from a railway line drawn on the 1899 Daehan Jeondo?
choices: that railway information appears on the map
that the maker depicted a route
whether that railway was actually open
the need to check its legend
questions.fact: A railway line on the 1899 Daehan Jeondo does not by itself establish [[whether that railway was actually open]] at that date.
questions.distractor: that railway information appears on the map
questions.explain: The archival description includes railways under construction or planned. Not every line represents an operating service.
blankDistractors: that railway information appears on the map
that the maker depicted a route
the need to check its legend

wrong.0: The presence of railway information can be observed on the map.
wrong.3: Checking the legend is necessary rather than unsupported.

questions.src: 국사편찬위원회 · 고종실록, 고종 19년 4월 7일 · https://sillok.history.go.kr/id/kza_11904007_001
questions.q: What visual and written records did Gojong ask Yi Gyu-won to submit after the 1882 inspection?
choices: a sailing permit and a passport
trade receipts and a bill of exchange
a household register and a marriage record
a map drawing and a separate written report
questions.fact: Gojong requested [[a map drawing and a separate written report]] following the 1882 Ulleungdo inspection.
questions.distractor: a sailing permit and a passport
questions.explain: The findings were to be recorded visually and in writing. The instruction connects field inspection with reporting.
blankDistractors: a sailing permit and a passport
trade receipts and a bill of exchange
a household register and a marriage record

wrong.0: This is not a pair of documents granting travel permission.
wrong.1: The instruction was not about financial settlement documents.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which reef near Dokdo was named in connection with seabirds frequently perching there?
questions.fact: The Dokdo marine place-name account associates [[Gwaengicho Reef]] with black-tailed gulls.
questions.explain: Marine place names can refer to nearby wildlife. Their origins are not limited to rock shapes.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 34–35쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=34&um=s | 농림축산식품부 BRIS·국립수목원 · 박주가리 · https://www.bris.go.kr/portal/book/childIlustbkDetailPopup.do?ilustbkNo=1158&menuId=114
questions.q: What form of dispersal is helped by the long white hairs on seeds of Metaplexis japonica, a plant in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The white seed hairs of Metaplexis japonica assist [[dispersal by wind]] as the seeds leave the fruit.
questions.explain: The botanical account links the silky hairs to wind transport. Seed movement differs from spreading by underground stems.

wrong.0: The feature described is long silky hair, not a hook.
wrong.2: This is another means of plant spread, not the role of seed hairs.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지명 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=65
questions.q: Which year does the official marine place-name account associate with the survey and naming of Gangchicho Reef?
questions.fact: The Dokdo marine place-name account links Gangchicho Reef's detailed survey and naming to [[2014]] in its chronology.
questions.explain: A reef's age and the date its name was recorded are different. Naming does not date the reef's formation.

wrong.3: This precedes the stated naming date by ten years.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 132–133쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=132&um=s
questions.q: Which bird in the Dokdo guide is listed as Treron sieboldii?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide identifies Treron sieboldii as the [[Japanese green pigeon]] in its bird section.
questions.explain: The guide describes a green-bodied pigeon. Its Dokdo observations should be distinguished from broader distribution or breeding accounts.

questions.src: 국가기록원 · 대한전도 · https://theme.archives.go.kr/next/dokdo/primaryList12.do
questions.q: How many provinces are distinguished on the 1899 Daehan Jeondo described by the National Archives?
questions.fact: The 1899 Daehan Jeondo distinguishes [[13 provinces]] in its administrative representation.
questions.explain: Not every historical Korean map uses the eight-province system. Read a map in the administrative context of its date.

wrong.2: This applies the familiar eight-province system to a different period.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 학술조사의 예산 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0030
questions.q: What purpose do publication, film, exhibition and lectures serve in the 1952 Dokdo expedition plan?
choices: communicating survey findings to the public
questions.fact: Publication, exhibitions and lectures in the 1952 expedition plan were activities for [[communicating survey findings to the public]] after the survey.
questions.explain: The plan included dissemination as well as fieldwork. It linked research to public education.

wrong.0: Publication and exhibition are contrary to permanent secrecy.
wrong.2: This is not the dissemination of survey findings described.

questions.src: 외교부 독도 · 칙령 제41호 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view02.jsp
questions.q: After which county did Article 3 of Imperial Edict No. 41 insert Uldo County in the county list?
questions.fact: Article 3 of Imperial Edict No. 41 places Uldo County immediately after [[Anhyeop County]] in the county list.
questions.explain: The article specifies where to amend an existing administrative list. It records a concrete administrative change.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 우리나라 지도에 나타난 독도 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/dokdo/item/level.do?levelId=eddok.d_0004_0060_0010
questions.q: Which atlas contains Aguk Chongdo in the Northeast Asian History Foundation's Dokdo map account?
questions.fact: The foundation identifies [[Yeojido]] as the atlas containing Aguk Chongdo.
questions.explain: A map's title can differ from the atlas containing it. Identifying both helps locate the source.

wrong.0: This is another atlas, not the stated container.
wrong.2: This confuses the source with that of maps such as Paldo Chongdo.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS Part XII · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part12.htm
questions.q: What principle in UNCLOS Article 195 applies to shifting pollution damage from one marine area to another?
choices: not transferring damage or hazards elsewhere
allowing any transfer across a border
granting immunity whenever a substance changes
questions.fact: UNCLOS Article 195 requires [[not transferring damage or hazards elsewhere]] when taking measures against marine pollution.
questions.distractor: allowing any transfer across a border
questions.explain: Reducing pollution in one place must not shift harm elsewhere. Merely transforming its form is not an adequate solution.
blankDistractors: allowing any transfer across a border
granting immunity whenever a substance changes

wrong.1: Crossing a border does not remove the non-transfer principle.
wrong.2: The article also addresses transforming one form of pollution into another.

questions.src: UN DOALOS · UNCLOS Part XII · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part12.htm
questions.q: What protection does UNCLOS Article 194(5) expressly include when conserving marine ecosystems such as those around Dokdo?
choices: only sales facilities for valuable fish
rare or fragile ecosystems and threatened-species habitats
only artificial structures in territorial seas
only the names of extinct species
questions.fact: UNCLOS Article 194(5) includes [[rare or fragile ecosystems and threatened-species habitats]] among the subjects of protective measures.
questions.distractor: only sales facilities for valuable fish
questions.explain: Protection is not limited to commercially saleable seafood. Ecosystems and habitats are expressly included.
blankDistractors: only sales facilities for valuable fish
only artificial structures in territorial seas
only the names of extinct species

wrong.0: The provision is not limited to commercial facilities.
wrong.2: It does not restrict protection to artificial structures.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 32–33쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=32&um=s
questions.q: Which climbing plant does the Dokdo guide list under Ampelopsis brevipedunculata?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide lists [[porcelain berry]] under Ampelopsis brevipedunculata.
questions.explain: This question links the names used in the 2017 guide. It does not test subsequent taxonomic revisions.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도의 저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=92
questions.q: What is the feeding mode of Dokdo benthic animals that capture food particles suspended in water?
questions.fact: Capturing food particles suspended in the water is [[suspension feeding]] among Dokdo benthic animals.
questions.explain: Living on the seabed does not mean obtaining all food from sediment. Moving water can carry food to an animal.

wrong.0: This obtains food from sediment rather than suspended particles.
wrong.1: This differs from producing organic matter using light.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 학술조사의 예산 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0030
questions.q: How many participants were envisaged in the July 1952 expedition plan described by the Northeast Asian History Foundation?
questions.fact: The July 1952 Ulleungdo–Dokdo expedition plan envisaged [[60 people]] as participants.
questions.explain: This is the planned headcount. It must not be quoted as the number who actually landed on Dokdo.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 34–35쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=34&um=s | 농림축산식품부 BRIS·국립수목원 · 박주가리 · https://www.bris.go.kr/portal/book/childIlustbkDetailPopup.do?ilustbkNo=1158&menuId=114
questions.q: Which climbing herb in the Dokdo guide releases white milky fluid when its stem is cut?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide describes [[Metaplexis japonica]] as a climbing herb whose cut stem releases milky fluid.
questions.explain: The feature helps identify the plant. Milky fluid does not establish that a plant is safe to eat or use medicinally.

wrong.0: This climber is not the species identified by the milky-fluid description.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 학술조사 준비 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0020
questions.q: What is the combined length of the two ropes listed for the 1953 Dokdo expedition?
questions.fact: The 30 m and 40 m ropes listed for the 1953 expedition have a combined length of [[70 m]] in the equipment plan.
questions.explain: This adds the two lengths in the historical list. It is not a standard rope requirement for every expedition.

wrong.0: This is the difference between the two lengths.
wrong.3: This includes only one of the two ropes.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 82–83쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=82&um=s
questions.q: For a variable species such as the ladybird in the Dokdo guide, what should not be concluded from color alone?
choices: patterns can vary within one species
differences between individuals can be recorded
different colors necessarily mean different species
questions.fact: Pattern variation in the guide's ladybird warns against assuming that [[different colors necessarily mean different species]] in identification.
questions.distractor: patterns can vary within one species
questions.explain: The guide emphasizes large variation in color and pattern. One visible difference does not necessarily define a species boundary.
blankDistractors: patterns can vary within one species
differences between individuals can be recorded

wrong.0: This agrees with the guide's description of variation within a species.
wrong.1: Comparing several traits is part of careful identification.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사의 여정 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0010
questions.q: From which mainland port did the 1947 expedition sail aboard Daejeon-ho to Ulleungdo?
questions.fact: The 1947 expedition departed from [[Pohang]] aboard Daejeon-ho for Ulleungdo.
questions.explain: The historical itinerary combines rail travel and a sea crossing. Today's ferry routes cannot be substituted for the recorded route.

wrong.1: This can confuse the trip with an expedition in another year.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 청구도 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0056274
questions.q: Which work does the Korean encyclopedia describe as Kim Jeong-ho's colored manuscript atlas?
questions.fact: The encyclopedia describes [[Cheonggudo]] as Kim Jeong-ho's colored manuscript atlas.
questions.explain: Kim Jeong-ho produced more than one cartographic work. Printed maps and manuscript atlases have different forms.

wrong.0: This confuses a famous woodblock map with the manuscript atlas.
wrong.2: This map is associated with Jeong Sang-gi, a different maker.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · Vascular Plants of Dokdo and Ulleungdo, 12–13쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=65&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=12&um=s
questions.q: In the account of Ulleungdo plant evolution, what model involves change within an immigrant lineage without branching on the island?
questions.fact: The Ulleungdo flora account discusses [[anagenesis]] as change within a lineage without local branching.
questions.explain: This is the book's interpretation of island plant evolution. It differs from a temporary response by one individual.

wrong.0: This involves diversification into multiple lineages.
wrong.3: A short-term condition of an individual is not lineage evolution.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 및 주변 해역 생물종 조사(2024) · 42–43쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=42&um=s
questions.q: What is appropriate when the 2024 Dokdo fish report cannot resolve a juvenile specimen to species?
choices: declare every difference from adults a new species
defer identification pending further specimens and traits
questions.fact: For an unresolved juvenile fish specimen, researchers should [[defer identification pending further specimens and traits]] rather than claim certainty.
questions.explain: The report identifies cases needing further examination. Recording uncertainty accurately states the evidence limit.
blankDistractors: declare every difference from adults a new species

wrong.0: Selecting a familiar name does not supply identification evidence.
wrong.1: Differences associated with growth do not by themselves establish a new species.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 24–25쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=24&um=s
questions.q: Which white-flowered coastal plant is listed as Arabis stelleri in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: Arabis stelleri is listed as [[coastal rockcress]] in the Dokdo guide.
questions.explain: The guide describes a white-flowered plant of coastal sand and rock crevices. Similar coastal habitats do not make all plants the same species.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 유기오염물질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=79
questions.q: In a Dokdo sediment concentration reported as ng/g dry weight, what mass does the denominator refer to?
choices: the mass of wet sediment including water
the combined mass of container and sample
the mass of all seawater collected
questions.fact: For a dry-weight concentration in Dokdo sediment, the denominator is [[the mass of dried sediment]] used for the measurement.
questions.distractor: the mass of wet sediment including water
questions.explain: Dry and wet weight are different measurement bases. Comparing them without adjustment can mislead.
blankDistractors: the mass of wet sediment including water
the combined mass of container and sample
the mass of all seawater collected

wrong.0: Dry weight excludes the sample's water mass.
wrong.2: The container mass is not part of the sediment mass.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 6–7쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=6&um=s
questions.q: Which starting year for the comprehensive inventory program is given in the introductory text of the 2017 Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The introductory account in the 2017 Dokdo guide gives [[2015]] as the start of its comprehensive inventory effort.
questions.explain: The question follows the introductory account in that guide. It should not be conflated with the date ranges of other program summaries.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 66–67쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=66&um=s
questions.q: Which plant bug in the Dokdo guide is described as green with irregular yellow spots?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide describes the [[goosefoot plant bug]] as green with irregular yellow spots.
questions.explain: This distinguishes similar plant-bug names. Not every bug observed on Dokdo is the species named Dokdo-jangnim-norinjae.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 및 주변 해역 생물종 조사(2024) · 42–43쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=42&um=s
questions.q: How many recorded fish taxa does the 2024 Dokdo report list after combining its work with earlier records?
questions.fact: The 2024 Dokdo fish report gives [[221 taxa]] in its combined inventory of records.
questions.explain: This is a cumulative inventory at the report's date. It is not the count seen during a single dive or a guaranteed present-day total.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 학술조사 준비 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0020
questions.q: Who was expected to provide specialized observation instruments in the 1953 expedition preparations?
choices: local residents alone for all equipment
joint purchase only after the survey
questions.fact: In the 1953 preparations, [[each specialist survey team]] was responsible for its specialized observation equipment.
questions.distractor: local residents alone for all equipment
questions.explain: Shared supplies were distinguished from specialist equipment. Different research tasks require different instruments.
blankDistractors: local residents alone for all equipment
joint purchase only after the survey

wrong.0: The document does not assign all specialist equipment to residents.
wrong.3: This concerns preparation before fieldwork.

questions.src: 국가기록원 · 대한전도 · https://theme.archives.go.kr/next/dokdo/primaryList12.do
questions.q: In what year was the thirteen-province Daehan Jeondo described by the National Archives published?
questions.fact: The National Archives dates the publication of the described Daehan Jeondo to [[1899]] in its catalog.
questions.explain: The date belongs to the version described in that archival entry. Similar map titles do not establish identical publication dates.

questions.src: Choi 외 · Dokdolipids A–C, Marine Drugs (2019) · https://www.mdpi.com/1660-3397/17/4/237/xml
questions.q: In which year did Marine Drugs publish the isolation and structures of dokdolipids A–C from a Dokdo-derived microorganism?
questions.fact: The Marine Drugs paper reporting dokdolipids A–C was published in [[2019]] after their isolation and characterization.
questions.explain: Sample collection and paper publication are different dates. Later publicity has another date again.

wrong.0: This confuses the collection year with the publication year.
wrong.2: This is the year after the paper was published.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 유기오염물질 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=79
questions.q: Do low pollutant levels measured in past Dokdo research make future monitoring unnecessary?
choices: continued inputs and changes must be monitored
questions.fact: Past low pollutant levels around Dokdo do not remove the need to recognize that [[continued inputs and changes must be monitored]] over time.
questions.explain: The official account warns that cleanliness then does not guarantee future conditions. Transport and environmental change still need attention.

wrong.1: This turns a past observation into an unsupported future guarantee.
wrong.2: This ignores transport by wind and currents.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 탄산염퇴적물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=97
questions.q: What must be considered when interpreting shallow-water shells in Dokdo sediments at depths of 20–100 m?
choices: certainty that every shell lived at that exact spot
the possibility that shells were transported before deposition
the claim that all deep water is fresh
the claim that only living organisms enter sediment
questions.fact: Interpreting shallow-water shells in Dokdo sediments at 20–100 m includes [[the possibility that shells were transported before deposition]] in the account.
questions.distractor: certainty that every shell lived at that exact spot
questions.explain: A sampling location need not be every producer's original habitat. Transport and redeposition are part of the sediment record.
blankDistractors: certainty that every shell lived at that exact spot
the claim that all deep water is fresh
the claim that only living organisms enter sediment

wrong.0: This equates the collection location with the original living habitat.
wrong.3: Shells from dead organisms can remain in sediment.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 108–109쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=108&um=s
questions.q: Which butterfly is listed as Colias erate in the Dokdo insect guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo insect guide identifies Colias erate as the [[eastern pale clouded yellow]] in its butterfly entries.
questions.explain: Other butterflies can share a similar color. The scientific name helps distinguish the entry.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도 해양생물자원의 활용 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=91
questions.q: Which benefit of producing research compounds from a cultured Dokdo microorganism directly concerns protecting natural populations?
choices: the need for all laboratory analysis
the need to identify the organism
the need to manage culture conditions
pressure from repeated collection in the natural habitat
questions.fact: A benefit of culturing Dokdo microorganisms directly related to protecting natural populations is reducing [[pressure from repeated collection in the natural habitat]] during research.
questions.distractor: the need for all laboratory analysis
questions.explain: Cultivation can reduce reliance on repeated wild collection. It does not eliminate culture management or chemical analysis.
blankDistractors: the need for all laboratory analysis
the need to identify the organism
the need to manage culture conditions

wrong.0: The compounds still require identification and analysis.
wrong.2: Culture conditions still need management.

questions.src: 외교부 독도 · 울도군 설치 청의서, 1900년 10월 22일 · https://dokdo.mofa.go.kr/kor/pds/part02_view01.jsp
questions.q: What month and day in 1900 are given on the proposal to establish Uldo County?
questions.fact: The 1900 Uldo County proposal bears the date [[October 22]] on the document.
questions.explain: Proposal, approval and gazette publication are separate administrative steps. One commemorative date cannot date every related document.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도의 저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=92
questions.q: Which common name matches Ophionereis dubia in the Dokdo benthic-fauna account?
questions.fact: The Dokdo benthic-fauna account lists Ophionereis dubia as the [[Julttakji brittle star]] in its species records.
questions.explain: Matching common and scientific names identifies the surveyed organism. A local record is not automatically a newly described species.

questions.src: Choi 외 · Dokdolipids A–C, Marine Drugs (2019) · https://www.mdpi.com/1660-3397/17/4/237/xml
questions.q: How many newly isolated compounds did the 2019 dokdolipid study report?
questions.fact: The 2019 study reports [[three compounds]] under the names dokdolipids A–C.
questions.explain: A, B and C label separately characterized compounds. They are not three nicknames for one substance.

wrong.0: This treats A, B and C as one substance.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 탄산염퇴적물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=97
questions.q: How does the Dokdo carbonate-sediment account link limited land-derived material to a high carbonate proportion?
choices: because the amount of land-derived grains increases
because dilution by land-derived grains is reduced
questions.fact: Carbonate grains can form a higher relative share [[because dilution by land-derived grains is reduced]] in the sediment mixture.
questions.distractor: because the amount of land-derived grains increases
questions.explain: A higher proportion does not necessarily mean more carbonate formed. The proportion can rise when fewer other grains are mixed in.
blankDistractors: because the amount of land-derived grains increases

wrong.0: With other factors unchanged, adding land-derived grains does not increase the carbonate proportion.
wrong.1: Carbonate content is related to its proportion relative to other grains.
wrong.2: The explanation concerns mixing proportions, not the chemical conversion of every grain.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지질환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=95
questions.q: Which main islet is identified in the geological account as exposing Dokdo's basal trachyte I?
questions.fact: The geological account identifies [[Seodo (West Islet)]] as the exposure site of Dokdo's basal trachyte I.
questions.explain: This asks where a particular rock unit is exposed. Both main islets need not expose identical sequences.

questions.src: 국가기록원 · 해좌전도 · https://theme.archives.go.kr/next/dokdo/primaryList17.do
questions.q: Which country's national library holds the Haejwa Jeondo described by the National Archives of Korea?
questions.fact: The national library holding the Haejwa Jeondo in the archival account is in [[France]] according to that description.
questions.explain: Historical Korean maps also survive in overseas collections. A holding location differs from a map's origin or depicted territory.

wrong.0: This is not the country of the holding library identified.
wrong.2: An overseas location does not make every country a correct answer.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 제5조 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/text/articles/default.shtml?sec=abs-05 | 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도 해양생물자원의 활용 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=91
questions.q: In ABS rules relevant to the use of biological resources such as Dokdo's, how are benefit-sharing terms established?
choices: automatically from the number of paper authors
questions.fact: Under Article 5 of the Nagoya Protocol, benefit-sharing is arranged [[through mutually agreed terms]] between the relevant parties.
questions.explain: Benefit-sharing is not a gift set solely at a researcher's discretion. Applicable law and agreed terms must be checked.
blankDistractors: automatically from the number of paper authors

wrong.0: This replaces mutual agreement with a unilateral notice.
wrong.3: Author count does not automatically determine benefit-sharing terms.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 제5조 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/text/articles/default.shtml?sec=abs-05 | 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 소개 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/about
questions.q: What can count as benefit-sharing alongside cash payments under the Nagoya Protocol?
choices: a declaration removing the provider's rights
exclusive control of data without agreement
non-monetary benefits such as research results
questions.fact: Benefit-sharing under the Nagoya Protocol may include [[non-monetary benefits such as research results]] alongside monetary benefits.
questions.explain: The protocol recognizes monetary and non-monetary benefits. The specific arrangement depends on agreed terms.
blankDistractors: a declaration removing the provider's rights
exclusive control of data without agreement

wrong.0: An unfulfilled promise is not the same as a delivered benefit.
wrong.1: Benefit-sharing is not a mechanism for removing the provider's rights.
wrong.2: Agreed sharing is different from unilateral exclusivity.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 36–37쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=36&um=s
questions.q: Which herb in the Dokdo guide has white flowers and black berries and is listed as Solanum nigrum?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide describes [[black nightshade]] under Solanum nigrum, with white flowers and black berries.
questions.explain: The question uses flowers and fruit for identification. It is not advice to eat wild berries.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도의 저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=92
questions.q: Which size group does the Dokdo benthic account describe as retained on a 1 mm or 0.5 mm sieve?
questions.fact: The Dokdo account uses retention on a 1 mm or 0.5 mm sieve to describe [[macrozoobenthos]] as a size category.
questions.explain: 'Macro' is a sampling size category, not a claim that the animals are huge. Read it with the sieve criterion.

wrong.0: This confuses the category with a smaller sieve-based group.
wrong.3: This replaces a benthic-animal group with phytoplankton.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 소개 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/about | 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도 해양생물자원의 활용 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=91
questions.q: In which year did the Nagoya Protocol, discussed in relation to biological-resource use, enter into force internationally?
questions.fact: The Nagoya Protocol on access and benefit-sharing entered into force internationally in [[2014]] as stated by the CBD Secretariat.
questions.explain: Its international entry into force was October 12, 2014. A country's accession or domestic implementation can have a different date.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 74–75쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=74&um=s
questions.q: Which insect is listed as Unkanodes sapporonus in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide lists Unkanodes sapporonus as the [[Unkanodes planthopper]] in its insect section.
questions.explain: Small insects are recorded under distinct names and groups. Similar size is not sufficient to combine them as one species.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판, 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: How many biological-group chapters form the main body of the revised Dokdo species inventory?
questions.fact: The revised Dokdo species inventory organizes its main biological groups into [[10 chapters]] in the main body.
questions.explain: The inventory separates groups from microorganisms to mammals. Its separate list of uncertain records should be distinguished from these chapters.

wrong.1: This confuses the illustrated guide's three sections with this inventory.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 및 주변 해역 생물종 조사(2024) · 38–39쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=38&um=s
questions.q: What does obtaining specimens of species previously unrepresented in the resource center mean in the 2024 Dokdo fish report?
choices: the species was discovered for the first time worldwide
filling a gap in that institution's specimen holdings
the species evolved on Dokdo that day
no institution previously had a specimen
questions.fact: Obtaining a specimen of a previously unrepresented species means [[filling a gap in that institution's specimen holdings]] in the collection account.
questions.distractor: the species was discovered for the first time worldwide
questions.explain: An institution's holdings are different from worldwide discovery. A collection gap is not an absence of the species.
blankDistractors: the species was discovered for the first time worldwide
the species evolved on Dokdo that day
no institution previously had a specimen

wrong.0: This confuses an institutional gap with worldwide discovery.
wrong.3: The statement does not establish what other institutions hold.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 34–35쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=34&um=s
questions.q: Which coastal plant is listed as Cnidium japonicum in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo plant guide lists Cnidium japonicum as [[coastal cnidium]] in its coastal flora.
questions.explain: This distinguishes plants sharing coastal habitats. White flowers alone do not identify every species.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 울릉도검찰일기 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0066658
questions.q: Which section of the Ulleungdo Inspection Diary is a draft memorial rather than daily entries?
questions.fact: The encyclopedia identifies a [[draft memorial (gyechobon)]] as a section distinct from the daily entries of the Ulleungdo Inspection Diary.
questions.explain: Daily entries and a draft memorial serve different functions. Reading the whole work as one uniform diary overlooks its report section.

wrong.2: The section is a draft survey memorial, not a financial settlement.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST 독도종합정보시스템 · 지질환경 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=95
questions.q: What basic grain-size trend is meant by inverse grading in the Dokdo volcanic-layer account?
choices: only color alternation unrelated to grain size
questions.fact: Inverse grading in Dokdo's volcaniclastic layers describes [[coarsening upward]] within a bed.
questions.explain: Grading direction is a clue to sedimentary structure. A trend within one bed differs from the ordering of separate beds.
blankDistractors: only color alternation unrelated to grain size

wrong.1: This describes the opposite, normal-grading direction.
wrong.3: Here, grading concerns grain size, not color alone.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · Vascular Plants of Dokdo and Ulleungdo, 12–13쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=65&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=12&um=s
questions.q: In the Ulleungdo flora account, what cannot be assumed merely because two island endemics belong to the same genus?
choices: that classification places them in the same genus
that they are closest relatives that split on the island
that their off-island relatives should also be compared
questions.fact: Two endemics in one Ulleungdo genus do not alone establish [[that they are closest relatives that split on the island]] in their evolutionary history.
questions.distractor: that classification places them in the same genus
questions.explain: The account notes cases closer to different off-island relatives than to one another. A genus name alone does not settle the evolutionary route.
blankDistractors: that classification places them in the same genus
that their off-island relatives should also be compared

wrong.0: Shared generic classification is a premise of the question.
wrong.2: Comparing off-island relatives is part of the necessary analysis.

questions.src: 독도재단 · 된장잠자리 · https://www.koreadokdo.or.kr/contents/sub03/page.html?mid=003007289&mode=view&no=84&start=12 | 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 62–63쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=62&um=s
questions.q: Which dragonfly does the Dokdo Foundation list as Pantala flavescens?
questions.fact: The Dokdo Foundation identifies Pantala flavescens as the [[globe skimmer]] in its species account.
questions.explain: This question links common and scientific names. Highly mobile insects are also part of Dokdo's biological records.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 및 주변 해역 생물종 조사(2024) · 18–19쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=18&um=s
questions.q: Why is animal-research ethical approval relevant in the 2024 Dokdo fish study?
choices: to abolish all other research permissions
to identify species solely by catch numbers
to have animal-handling research procedures reviewed
questions.fact: Ethical approval is obtained [[to have animal-handling research procedures reviewed]] in the Dokdo fish research process.
questions.explain: Identification and ethical review serve different roles. Neither automatically replaces the other.
blankDistractors: to abolish all other research permissions
to identify species solely by catch numbers

wrong.0: Ethical approval does not grant authority to rename species.
wrong.1: It does not automatically waive other legal permissions.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 소개 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/about
questions.q: In which year was the Nagoya Protocol on access to genetic resources and benefit-sharing adopted?
questions.fact: The Nagoya Protocol on access and benefit-sharing was adopted in [[2010]] according to the CBD Secretariat.
questions.explain: This is part of the international background relevant to biological-resource research. Adoption and entry into force are different dates.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 54–55쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=54&um=s
questions.q: Which plant does the Dokdo guide list as Allium macrostemon?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide gives [[long-stamen chive]] as the common-name match for Allium macrostemon.
questions.explain: The question distinguishes similar onion and chive names. Identification here is not permission to collect or eat wild plants.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도 해양생물자원의 활용 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=91 | Choi 외 · Dokdolipids A–C, Marine Drugs (2019) · https://www.mdpi.com/1660-3397/17/4/237/xml
questions.q: In which year was the original Dokdo sediment sample for the dokdolipid-producing actinomycete collected?
questions.fact: The Dokdo sediment sample yielding the actinomycete for dokdolipid research was collected in [[2017]] before the paper appeared.
questions.explain: The official account dates collection to September 2017. Cultivation, isolation and publication followed as separate steps.

questions.src: Choi 외 · Dokdolipids A–C, Marine Drugs (2019) · https://www.mdpi.com/1660-3397/17/4/237/xml
questions.q: What did NMR and mass-spectrometric data principally help establish in the dokdolipid paper?
choices: the structures of the isolated compounds
questions.fact: NMR and mass-spectrometric data in the dokdolipid study help establish [[the structures of the isolated compounds]] through chemical analysis.
questions.explain: Obtaining a substance differs from determining what it is. Analytical data support chemical identification.

wrong.0: This combination is not used to determine navigation routes.
wrong.1: Chemical analysis does not define administrative boundaries.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 한국향토문화전자대전 · 울도기 · https://rinks.aks.ac.kr/Portal/ContentsView?sCode=GC&sId=GC01500488
questions.q: Whom does the Uldogi commentary identify as the gamniseo clerk accompanying the 1900 survey?
questions.fact: The Uldogi commentary names [[Kim Myeon-su]] as the gamniseo clerk accompanying the 1900 survey.
questions.explain: The delegation was not just its best-known representative. Matching names with roles clarifies its composition.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 울릉도검찰일기 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0066658
questions.q: Which collection holds the Ulleungdo inner and outer maps associated with Yi Gyu-won's report to the king?
questions.fact: The encyclopedia identifies [[Kyujanggak]] as the holding collection for Yi Gyu-won's Ulleungdo maps.
questions.explain: The diary's transmission and the maps' holding collection are separate questions. Records from one survey can survive through different routes.

wrong.0: Exhibiting Dokdo material does not make it the holding collection for these maps.
wrong.2: Being a maritime institution does not identify it as this collection.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 제6조 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/text/articles/default.shtml?sec=abs-06
questions.q: Under Article 6 of the Nagoya Protocol, what is the basic access procedure where required by the provider country's rules?
questions.fact: Where required by the provider country's rules, access to genetic resources is subject to [[prior informed consent]] under Article 6.
questions.explain: Domestic rules and the provider's decisions determine applicable conditions. The provision is not an identical procedure for every organism everywhere.

wrong.0: This replaces an advance requirement with a later notice.
wrong.3: Journal procedures are not resource-access authorization.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 제5조 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/text/articles/default.shtml?sec=abs-05 | 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 소개 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/about
questions.q: What knowledge associated with genetic resources is also addressed by the Nagoya Protocol?
choices: all historical knowledge of every country
traditional knowledge associated with genetic resources
questions.fact: The Nagoya Protocol also addresses [[traditional knowledge associated with genetic resources]] within its scope.
questions.distractor: all historical knowledge of every country
questions.explain: It also addresses relations with communities holding relevant traditional knowledge. It does not automatically cover all knowledge labeled traditional.
blankDistractors: all historical knowledge of every country

wrong.0: This expands the scope to all historical knowledge.
wrong.1: An unrelated timetable is not the knowledge category addressed.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 136–137쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=136&um=s
questions.q: Which bird is listed as Halcyon pileata in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide lists Halcyon pileata as the [[black-capped kingfisher]] in its bird entries.
questions.explain: The guide describes a black head, blue wings and a large red bill. Scientific names help distinguish similar bird names.

questions.src: 황상구·전영권 · 독도 화산의 분출윤회와 화산형태 (2003), 자원환경지질 36(6) · https://www.koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO200311922118921.pub?lang=ko
questions.q: What does the 2003 paper mean when it says Dokdo's submarine volcano resembles a shield volcano?
questions.fact: The shield-volcano comparison in the 2003 Dokdo paper describes [[similarity of external shape]] in its underwater form.
questions.explain: The paper describes the form beneath sea level. A comparison of shape is different from a finding about internal rocks.

wrong.0: Resemblance of shape does not establish identical internal rocks.
wrong.2: Comparing shapes is not an observation of a current eruption.
wrong.3: A description of form does not provide a growth rate.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 울릉도·독도 학술조사의 여정 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0002_0010
questions.q: From which port did the 1952 expedition depart for Ulleungdo aboard Jinnam-ho?
questions.fact: The 1952 expedition sailed for Ulleungdo aboard Jinnam-ho from [[Busan]] according to its itinerary.
questions.explain: The 1947 and 1952 departure records differ. Read the year and vessel together to avoid mixing itineraries.

wrong.0: This confuses the departure point with the 1947 expedition.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 70–71쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=70&um=s
questions.q: Which insect is listed as Hishimonus sellatus in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo insect guide identifies Hishimonus sellatus as the [[Hishimonus leafhopper]] in its entries.
questions.explain: Small leafhoppers are also part of plant-associated ecosystems. Matching names accurately distinguishes what was observed.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도 생물종 목록집 개정판, 일러두기 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1203&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=2&um=s
questions.q: How many species does the revised Dokdo inventory say it added relative to the 2015 list?
questions.fact: The revised Dokdo inventory reports [[718 species]] added relative to the 2015 list.
questions.explain: This counts additions to a documented list. It does not mean all those species evolved or arrived during that interval.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 탄산염퇴적물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=97
questions.q: What grain property is described by roundness in the Dokdo sediment account?
choices: how rounded its edges have become through wear
questions.fact: Roundness in the Dokdo sediment description expresses [[how rounded its edges have become through wear]] as a grain characteristic.
questions.explain: Size and shape provide different information. Similarly sized grains can have differently worn edges.

wrong.0: This is not a measure of brightness or color.
wrong.3: The term concerns grain shape, not seawater chemistry.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 한국향토문화전자대전 · 울도기 · https://rinks.aks.ac.kr/Portal/ContentsView?sCode=GC&sId=GC01500488
questions.q: Whom does the Uldogi commentary list as bongpan in the 1900 survey party?
questions.fact: The Uldogi commentary lists [[Kim Seong-won]] as bongpan in the 1900 survey party.
questions.explain: Participants in one delegation held different roles. This question distinguishes similar names using their recorded positions.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 144–145쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=144&um=s
questions.q: Which small bird is listed as Regulus regulus japonensis in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide lists Regulus regulus japonensis as the [[goldcrest]] in its bird section.
questions.explain: The guide highlights yellow and orange markings along the crown. Small birds also require comparison of detailed traits.

wrong.0: This is a different nearby entry with a distinctive flank pattern.
wrong.1: This is another bird entry and does not match the scientific name.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 제6조 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/text/articles/default.shtml?sec=abs-06
questions.q: In what form does Article 6 of the Nagoya Protocol say mutually agreed access terms should be set out?
questions.fact: Article 6 of the Nagoya Protocol calls for [[terms set out in writing]] for mutually agreed access arrangements.
questions.explain: Recording the terms helps clarify what was agreed. A researcher's private note is not an agreement with the other party.

wrong.1: This does not meet the requirement to set the terms out in writing.
wrong.2: Possessing notes is different from having mutually agreed terms.

questions.src: Choi 외 · Dokdolipids A–C, Marine Drugs (2019) · https://www.mdpi.com/1660-3397/17/4/237/xml
questions.q: What comparison did the dokdolipid study use in HPLC analysis to determine the form of its sugar component?
choices: time values from different conditions alone
reference standards analyzed under the same conditions
questions.fact: The HPLC assignment of the sugar component in the dokdolipid study used [[reference standards analyzed under the same conditions]] as its comparison.
questions.distractor: time values from different conditions alone
questions.explain: Retention times must be interpreted with the analytical conditions. A matching number alone is not enough to establish identity.
blankDistractors: time values from different conditions alone

wrong.0: Times obtained under different conditions are not directly comparable.
wrong.2: The sugar form was not assigned from the culture medium's acidity alone.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 82–83쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=82&um=s
questions.q: Which species is listed as Coccinella septempunctata in the Dokdo insect guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide identifies Coccinella septempunctata as the [[seven-spot ladybird]] in its insect entries.
questions.explain: The guide describes seven black spots across the two wing cases. The broad label ladybird does not identify every species.

questions.src: 해양수산부·KIOST · 독도의 저서동물 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=92
questions.q: Where do deposit-feeding benthic animals around Dokdo obtain their food?
choices: organic matter in or on sediment
questions.fact: Deposit feeding by Dokdo benthic animals uses [[organic matter in or on sediment]] as a food source.
questions.explain: Organic matter associated with bottom particles can provide food. Seabed food webs contain different feeding modes.

wrong.0: This does not describe a sediment-associated food source.
wrong.2: This confuses animal feeding with photosynthesis.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 울릉도검찰일기 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0066658
questions.q: Which inspector is identified by the pen name Maneun in the encyclopedia's Ulleungdo Inspection Diary account?
questions.fact: The encyclopedia's diary account associates the pen name Maneun with [[Yi Gyu-won]] as inspector.
questions.explain: Historical records may use a pen name instead of a personal name. Linking them avoids treating one person as two.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 58–59쪽 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=58&um=s
questions.q: Which plant does the Dokdo guide list as Chenopodium album var. stenophyllum, with narrow lance-shaped leaves?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide lists [[narrow-leaved goosefoot]] under Chenopodium album var. stenophyllum.
questions.explain: The question follows the guide's name and leaf description. Similar goosefoot names still require comparison of details.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 소개 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/about
questions.q: According to the CBD Secretariat, the Nagoya Protocol entered into force 90 days after the deposit of which numbered instrument of ratification?
questions.fact: The CBD account links the protocol's entry into force to [[the fiftieth]] instrument of ratification, followed by ninety days.
questions.explain: Adoption did not immediately trigger entry into force. A treaty has procedural conditions for becoming effective.

wrong.0: This is below the deposit number stated by the Secretariat.

questions.src: 한국관광공사 · 숫돌바위 (울릉도, 독도 국가지질공원) · https://korean.visitkorea.or.kr/detail/ms_detail.do?cotid=603167d6-1056-43c1-8a3d-c8640dd25938
questions.q: Which orientation of rock columns is described at Dokdo's Sutdolbawi Rock?
questions.fact: The columns described at Dokdo's Sutdolbawi Rock have [[a horizontal orientation]] in the geological-site account.
questions.explain: Columnar joints divide rock into column-like forms. Their columns do not always stand vertically.

wrong.0: This site is described as having horizontally lying columns.
wrong.1: A radial arrangement is not what this source describes.
wrong.2: The account explicitly describes horizontally oriented columns.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 70–71쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=70&um=s
questions.q: Which insect is listed as Nezara antennata in the Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide identifies Nezara antennata as the [[green stink bug]] in its insect list.
questions.explain: The guide also describes color variation in this species. A common name need not match every individual's present color.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017) · 54–55쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=54&um=s
questions.q: Which coastal plant in the Dokdo guide has more branching and longer inflorescence bristles than ordinary green foxtail?
questions.fact: The Dokdo guide distinguishes [[coastal foxtail]] by more branching and longer bristles than ordinary green foxtail.
questions.explain: This uses fine structural traits to distinguish similar grasses. Bristle length and branching are observation clues.

wrong.0: This is the ordinary green foxtail used for comparison.
wrong.2: This is another foxtail with a similar common name.

questions.src: 생물다양성협약 사무국 · 나고야의정서 제6조 · https://www.cbd.int/abs/text/articles/default.shtml?sec=abs-06
questions.q: Under Nagoya Protocol Article 6, who provides the clear written decision on a prior-informed-consent application?
choices: an arbitrary group chosen by a specimen seller
questions.fact: Article 6 assigns the clear written decision on prior informed consent to [[a competent national authority]] under the applicable access system.
questions.explain: An applicant cannot create their own authorization and call it approval. The competent decision-making authority matters.
blankDistractors: an arbitrary group chosen by a specimen seller

wrong.0: This confuses the applicant with the approving authority.
wrong.1: Academic opinion and legal access approval are different.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 한국향토문화전자대전 · 울도기 · https://rinks.aks.ac.kr/Portal/ContentsView?sCode=GC&sId=GC01500488
questions.q: What reading approach is needed when the Uldogi commentary flags problems with some reported titles and headcounts?
choices: accept every old statement as established fact
discard the entire source because of one error
critically compare even the original account with other evidence
questions.fact: The commentary's criticism of parts of Uldogi shows the need to [[critically compare even the original account with other evidence]] when interpreting a historical source.
questions.distractor: accept every old statement as established fact
questions.explain: Contemporary origin is valuable but does not guarantee every statement's accuracy. Separate problematic passages from usable evidence.
blankDistractors: accept every old statement as established fact
discard the entire source because of one error

wrong.0: This confuses the value of a primary source with infallibility.
wrong.1: A local error does not erase the value of the whole source.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 40–41쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=40&um=s
questions.q: Which bellflower-family plant endemic to Korea appears in the 2017 Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: [[Campanula takesimana]] is the endemic bellflower described in the 2017 Dokdo guide.
questions.explain: The guide records this plant on both islands. Endemic to Korea does not mean confined to Dokdo.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 12–13쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=12&um=s
questions.q: Which floral structure does the 2017 guide say is absent in Tetragonia tetragonoides?
questions.fact: The 2017 guide describes [[petals]] as absent from Tetragonia flowers.
questions.explain: The guide describes flowers without petals. This does not mean the plant has no flowers.

wrong.0: The guide describes flowers without petals.
wrong.2: This does not mean the plant has no flowers.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 한국산악회 자료집: 해방 후 울릉도·독도 학술조사 관련 자료 해설 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0006_0020
questions.q: Who appears as civil administrator in records about organizing the 1947 island expedition?
questions.fact: [[An Jae-hong]] is the civil administrator named in the 1947 expedition records.
questions.explain: An was the civil administrator mentioned in the records. That role differs from a field researcher.

wrong.0: An was the civil administrator mentioned in the records.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 106–107쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=106&um=s
questions.q: Which butterfly in the 2017 Dokdo guide has caterpillars with snake-eye-like markings?
questions.fact: [[Papilio xuthus]] is the butterfly whose larval eye-like markings are described in the guide.
questions.explain: The markings are on the caterpillar's third segment. They are not adult wing markings.

wrong.0: The markings are on the caterpillar's third segment.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전: 청구도 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0056274
questions.q: How many volumes form Cheonggudo as described by the Academy of Korean Studies?
questions.fact: [[2 volumes]] form the basic Cheonggudo set described in the encyclopedia.
questions.explain: Cheonggudo consists of two volumes. Volume count is not a count of mapped regions.

wrong.1: Cheonggudo consists of two volumes.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 20–21쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=20&um=s
questions.q: What does 'planted' mean in the guide's distribution entry for Fallopia sachalinensis on Dokdo?
choices: a record of naming a new species
questions.fact: The planting label for Fallopia on Dokdo denotes [[a record of human planting]] in the guide.
questions.explain: The Dokdo entry explicitly notes planting. Omitting that label would erase an important distinction.
blankDistractors: a record of naming a new species
