wrong.0: The Dokdo entry explicitly notes planting.
wrong.2: Omitting that label would erase an important distinction.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 한국산악회 자료집: 1953년 울릉도·독도 학술조사 편성 및 행동 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0005_0010
questions.q: Which venue hosted the 1947 expedition exhibition recalled in the 1953 records?
questions.fact: [[Donghwa Department Store]] is the 1947 exhibition venue recalled in the 1953 records.
questions.explain: The records name Donghwa as the exhibition venue. It was not the expedition's field site.

wrong.0: The records name Donghwa as the exhibition venue.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 12–13쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=12&um=s
questions.q: Which plant name corresponds to Atriplex gmelinii in the 2017 Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: [[Ganeungaenneungjaengi]] is the Korean plant name paired with Atriplex gmelinii in the guide.
questions.explain: The guide describes a coastal salt-tolerant plant. Compare scientific names as well as similar Korean names.

wrong.0: Compare scientific names as well as similar Korean names.

questions.src: 유엔 해양법 담당 부서 · UNCLOS 제13부 제248·249조 · https://www.un.org/depts/los/convention_agreements/texts/unclos/part13.htm
questions.q: Under UNCLOS Article 249, when must a coastal state be informed of a major research-program change?
choices: notification only in an annual report
questions.fact: Article 249 requires [[immediate notification]] of major changes to the research program.
questions.explain: This is the condition in Article 249(1)(f). It is separate from submitting final results.
blankDistractors: notification only in an annual report

wrong.1: This is the condition in Article 249(1)(f).
wrong.2: It is separate from submitting final results.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 울릉도·독도의 생물다양성 특성 연구(2024), 34–35쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=1362&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=34&um=s
questions.q: What is wrong with relabeling the 2024 mainland-coast count of 121 fish species as a Dokdo count?
questions.fact: Relabeling the mainland count as Dokdo's count entails [[mixing distinct survey areas]] in the report.
questions.explain: The 121-species count belongs to the mainland comparison survey. Sharing a report does not make locations identical.

wrong.0: The 121-species count belongs to the mainland comparison survey.
wrong.2: Sharing a report does not make locations identical.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 134–135쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=134&um=s
questions.q: Which bird in the 2017 Dokdo guide has slender sickle-shaped wings and a white rump?
questions.fact: [[Pacific swift]] is the bird described with sickle-shaped wings and a white rump in the guide.
questions.explain: These are identifying flight features of the swift. The white rump matters even when the body looks dark.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성(2017), 발간사·목차 · https://nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=4&um=s
questions.q: Which three groups are covered in NIBR's 2017 illustrated Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: The three groups are [[land plants, insects and birds]] in the 2017 illustrated guide.
questions.explain: The contents are divided into land plants, insects and birds. This is not the later marine-life photographic guide.

wrong.0: The contents are divided into land plants, insects and birds.
wrong.1: This is not the later marine-life photographic guide.

questions.src: 한국학중앙연구원 · 한국민족문화대백과사전: 청구도 · https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0056274
questions.q: Who wrote Cheonggudo-je, the prefatory text associated with Kim Jeong-ho's Cheonggudo?
questions.fact: [[Choe Han-gi]] wrote the prefatory Cheonggudo-je text.
questions.explain: The mapmaker and the preface writer are different people. Their roles should not be merged.

wrong.1: The mapmaker and the preface writer are different people.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 16–17쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=16&um=s
questions.q: Which yellow-flowered plant is paired with Portulaca oleracea in the 2017 Dokdo guide?
questions.fact: [[Purslane]] is the plant paired with Portulaca oleracea in the 2017 guide.
questions.explain: The guide includes yellow-flowered purslane. Being recorded on Dokdo does not make a species endemic there.

wrong.0: The guide includes yellow-flowered purslane.

questions.src: 동북아역사재단 · 한국산악회 자료집: 1953년 울릉도·독도 학술조사 편성 및 행동 · https://contents.nahf.or.kr/iscac/contents/viewer.do?levelId=iscac.d_0005_0010
questions.q: What is the combined nominal capacity of two seven-person tents and one two-person tent in the 1953 plan?
questions.fact: The three tents provide [[16 places]] at their combined nominal capacities.
questions.explain: Calculate seven times two, plus two. This is planned capacity, not actual occupancy.

wrong.0: Calculate seven times two, plus two.

questions.src: 국립생물자원관 · 독도의 생물다양성: 육상식물·곤충·조류(2017), 106–107쪽 · https://www.nibr.go.kr/aiibook/access/ecatalogt.jsp?Dir=78&callmode=admin&eclang=ko&start=106&um=s
questions.q: What relationship is described when Diglyphus larvae feed while attached to leafminer larvae?
questions.fact: The guide describes [[external parasitism]] by Diglyphus larvae on leafminer larvae.
questions.explain: The larva feeds while attached outside its host. The description does not imply that both organisms benefit.

wrong.0: The larva feeds while attached outside its host.
wrong.1: The description does not imply that both organisms benefit.

questions.src: 해양수산부·한국해양과학기술원 · 독도종합정보시스템: 화산체의 특성 · https://www.dokdo.re.kr/home/cms/cmsCont.do?cntnts_sn=94
questions.q: Which seamount lies southeast of Dokdo's volcanic edifice, separated by a saddle?
questions.fact: [[Sim Heung-taek Seamount]] lies beyond the saddle southeast of Dokdo's volcanic edifice.
